    "9-10": "视频中有三位及以上用户详细讲述其积极体验，涵盖不同服务环节；全面展示四项及以上第三方认证（如奖项、合作伙伴、技术专利），并详细解释其权威性；包含多个透明流程演示（如AI定价、全维检测）；详细阐述多项售后保障（如2年保修、30天无忧退换、在线技术支援），并强调其覆盖范围及优势。",
    "11-12": "视频中有四位及以上用户从多角度深度分享其成功经验，突出平台差异化优势；详尽展示五项及以上第三方认证（如奖项、合作机构、行业认可），并通过数据或案例强化其可信度；包含多场景透明流程演示（如区块链记录、智能物流）；全面详述所有售后保障措施（如2年保修、30天无忧退换、终身护航），结合实例展示其实际效果，消除用户所有顾虑。"
  },
  {
    "name": "关键信息密度与差异化竞争呈现",
    "criteria_description": "检查50秒内是否有效涵盖平台的核心服务（全维检测、公平议价、跨域交付、终身护航）及促销亮点，并突出平台区别于其他二手车交易对手的独特性（如30天无忧退换、全国3日送达）。",
    "1-2": "未提及平台四大核心服务中的至少三项，且完全缺失促销亮点或独特性描述，信息稀疏且无差异化竞争优势呈现。",
    "3-4": "仅覆盖两项核心服务（如全维检测、公平议价），简要提及一项促销亮点（如30天无忧退换），但缺乏具体细节支撑，未能有效突出平台与其他竞品的区别。",
    "5-6": "明确涵盖三项核心服务（如全维检测、公平议价、跨域交付）及一项促销亮点（如全国3日送达），提供基础解释说明，初步展示平台独特价值主张，但表述较泛，细节不足。",
    "7-8": "完整覆盖四大核心服务（全维检测、公平议价、跨域交付、终身护航），并详细阐述至少两项促销亮点（如30天无忧退换、全国3日送达），结合实例或场景化语言强化可信度，差异化优势明显。",
    "9-10": "全面涵盖四大核心服务及全部促销亮点（30天无忧退换、全国3日送达），采用对比手法直接凸显平台相对于其他二手车交易对手的优越性，逻辑清晰，数据或案例引用精准，增强说服力。",
    "11-12": "在9-10分基础上，创新性地整合核心服务与促销亮点，通过故事叙述或互动形式展现用户体验流程，生动演绎“安全、智能、轻松、划算、放心”的品牌感知，激发观众共鸣，营销效果显著。",
    "13-14": "不仅满足前述所有要求，还能巧妙运用视觉元素（如动画演示、用户证言）、节奏把控（快剪快播）和情绪调动技巧（幽默/惊喜/信任感），实现高密度信息传递与高度品牌认同的融合，达到卓越传播效果。"
  },
  {
    "name": "视觉冲击力与脚本节奏控制",
    "criteria_description": "评价视频开头3秒是否具备吸引眼球的设计（如动态特效、震撼画面、悬念问题），并评估50秒内的时间分配是否合理，确保整体节奏紧凑不拖沓。",
    "1-2": "视频开头3秒无动态特效或震撼画面，未提出悬念问题，无法吸引眼球；50秒内时间分配松散，关键环节缺失，节奏拖沓，存在明显冗余片段。",
    "3-4": "视频开头3秒包含简单动态特效但缺乏视觉焦点，或提出普通问题但未形成强烈悬念；50秒内时间分配基本覆盖主要环节，但部分环节时长不合理，节奏略显平缓，偶有拖沓。",
    "5-6": "视频开头3秒采用中等强度动态特效（如快速切换镜头、局部放大）或提出一般性悬念问题，初步引起观众兴趣；50秒内时间分配合理，关键环节清晰呈现，节奏紧凑但个别环节转换稍显生硬。",
    "7-8": "视频开头3秒运用高强度视觉冲击设计（如爆炸式转场、高对比色彩突变）或提出引人深思的悬念问题，立即抓住注意力；50秒内时间分配高度优化，各环节衔接流畅，节奏明快且张弛有度，无冗余内容。",
    "9-10": "视频开头3秒结合多重动态特效（如粒子动画+全景缩放）与强悬念问题，形成强烈视听冲击；50秒内时间分配精确到秒级，每个镜头服务于核心信息传递，节奏紧凑且富有层次，全程无冷场或冗余。",
    "11-12": "视频开头3秒通过创新视觉设计（如AR虚拟场景切入）与高张力悬念问题，创造沉浸式观看体验；50秒内时间分配实现精准匹配信息密度与观众认知负荷，节奏控制体现艺术性与专业性，整体观感如行云流水。",
    "13-14": "视频开头3秒以突破性视觉技术（如实时渲染特效+互动元素）与极具话题性的悬念问题，彻底颠覆传统短视频开场模式；50秒内时间分配达到毫秒级精度，节奏变化符合心理学规律，全程保持观众高度参与感与情感共鸣。"
  },
  {
    "name": "技术细节可视化与目标受众契合度",
    "criteria_description": "衡量区块链、物联网、AI等抽象技术是否通过图表、动画或实景演示转化为易懂的视觉内容，并评估脚本是否针对抖音主流用户（年轻群体、下沉市场车主等）设计语言风格和内容偏好。",
    "1-2": "视频未使用任何视觉辅助手段解释技术，仅用文字或口头描述区块链、物联网、AI等概念；脚本语言风格与主流抖音用户脱节，内容偏好偏向专业或传统媒体。",
    "3-4": "视频尝试使用简单图表或动画展示部分技术细节，但转化不够直观或易懂，未能完全将抽象概念转化为大众可理解的内容；脚本语言风格有一定年轻化元素，但内容偏好未能完全契合下沉市场车主的需求。",
    "5-6": "视频通过图表、动画或实景演示成功将大部分抽象技术转化为易懂的视觉内容，但某些复杂概念仍存在一定理解门槛；脚本语言风格明显针对年轻群体和下沉市场车主，但内容偏好仍有提升空间，未能完全激发目标受众兴趣。",
    "7-8": "视频全面利用图表、动画或实景演示将抽象技术高度可视化，几乎所有技术细节都易于理解；脚本语言风格和内容偏好完全契合抖音主流用户，包括轻松幽默的语言和实际利益点，如折扣、保障等。",
    "9-10": "视频通过创新的视觉手段（如互动式动画或虚拟现实）将抽象技术细节极致简化，观众无需任何背景知识即可理解；脚本语言风格和内容偏好高度契合抖音平台，不仅涵盖轻松、划算、放心的品牌感知，还巧妙结合了热点话题和流行梗，极大提升传播效果。",
    "11-12": "视频在技术细节可视化和受众契合度上达到卓越水平，采用前沿视觉技术（如AR/VR）并融合实景演示，实现技术与内容的完美平衡；脚本不仅精准针对抖音主流用户设计，还通过个性化互动和实时反馈机制，显著增强用户参与感，树立行业标杆。"
  },
  {
    "name": "行动号召明确性与品牌一致性",
    "criteria_description": "检查结尾是否有清晰的CTA（Call To Action），如“立即扫码下单”“点击链接领取优惠券”，并配合二维码、悬浮窗等引导转化工具，同时确保视觉风格（色调、字体、LOGO位置）、声音标识（背景音乐、配音音色）符合车轮易购现有品牌形象。",
    "1-2": "结尾无明确CTA，或仅有模糊提示如“欢迎选购”，未使用二维码、悬浮窗等转化工具；视觉风格（色调、字体、LOGO位置）与车轮易购品牌形象明显不符，声音标识（背景音乐、配音音色）完全缺失或不符合品牌标准。",
    "3-4": "CTA存在但不够清晰，例如仅显示“了解更多”而未具体引导扫码或点击链接；二维码或悬浮窗出现但不突出或不易被用户发现；视觉风格部分符合品牌要求，但色调、字体或LOGO位置存在偏差；声音标识部分匹配品牌特征，但背景音乐或配音音色不一致。",
    "5-6": "CTA明确且直接，如“立即扫码下单”，但二维码或悬浮窗展示时间较短或位置不佳；视觉风格基本符合品牌规范，色调、字体和LOGO位置接近标准，但细节处理不到位；声音标识整体匹配品牌，但背景音乐或配音音色略有差异。",
    "7-8": "CTA清晰且突出，包含具体引导语并配合二维码、悬浮窗等转化工具，确保用户易于操作；视觉风格高度一致，色调、字体和LOGO位置严格遵循品牌标准，细节处理到位；声音标识完全符合品牌要求，背景音乐和配音音色与品牌形象高度一致。",
    "9-10": "CTA不仅明确且具有创意性，如动态引导“点击领取专属优惠券”，并配以互动式二维码或悬浮窗，极大提升转化率；视觉风格完美呈现品牌元素，色调、字体、LOGO及整体布局均体现专业设计感；声音标识精准匹配品牌特征，背景音乐节奏与配音音色协同强化品牌认知。",
    "11-12": "CTA极具吸引力且多维度覆盖，结合用户心理设计多重引导（如“限时优惠”“扫码即得”），并通过动画、音效等方式增强互动性；视觉风格在严格保持品牌一致性的基础上，通过微创新提升观感体验；声音标识不仅完全符合品牌标准，还通过声音特效（如提示音）进一步强化行动号召力。"
  }
]

system: 我是经济学专业大三学生，请帮我撰写一份大学生的入党申请书。需要涵盖如下部分：1) 个人学历信息及奖学金获取记录；2) 担任班委的具体职能、核心任务与达成效果；3) 研读党的指导思想的收获，聚焦马克思主义中国化进程；4) 经历过的党组织生活及社会公益活动；5) 个人的政治信仰和申请入党的缘由；6) 在经济学科推动国家进步的实施策略。请用恳切的措辞表述入党志向。
solution:
[
  {
    "name": "个人学历与奖学金信息完整性",
    "criteria_description": "评估申请书中是否清晰列出学习经历和获奖记录，准确体现学术能力和勤奋态度，为党组织考察综合素质提供基础数据。",
    "1-2": "仅提及部分学历信息（如入学年份或专业），未说明具体学习经历；奖学金信息完全缺失，或仅简单提及“曾获奖励”但无具体时间、奖项名称、授予单位等关键信息。",
    "3-4": "列出基本学历信息（如大学及专业）和1-2项奖学金，但缺乏细节（如缺少获奖年份、等级、评选标准）；学习经历描述笼统，未能体现课程难度或学术挑战应对情况。",
    "5-6": "明确列出完整学习经历（含起止时间、院校、专业），并详细说明至少两项奖学金（包括获奖时间、奖项全称、评选条件、个人贡献）；能简要说明某次获奖与特定学业成果（如高分课程、研究项目）的关联性。",
    "7-8": "提供详尽的学习经历（如核心课程、GPA趋势、海外交流等），并系统归纳3项及以上奖学金（按时间顺序排列，含颁发机构、竞争比例、个人优势分析）；突出一次高难度获奖经历（如国家级/校长特别奖），并说明其如何反映学术能力和持续努力。",
    "9-10": "除完整学历和多项奖学金外，补充量化数据（如专业排名、绩点对比、获奖次数统计），并通过具体案例（如以第一作者发表课程论文、独立完成调研项目）证明学术能力；奖学金描述中体现差异化优势（如唯一获奖者、跨学科竞赛奖项），展现勤奋态度与卓越表现。",
    "11-12": "在全面覆盖学历和获奖记录基础上，深入分析自身学术成长路径（如从大一普通成绩到大三顶尖排名的进步过程），并关联党组织考察要求（如引用党内青年培养政策说明个人发展契合度）；所有信息均具备可验证性（如注明“参见附件成绩单第X页”或“XX奖学金公示链接”），形成高度可信的数据支撑体系。"
  },
  {
    "name": "班委职责与成效描述具体性",
    "criteria_description": "衡量是否能详述班委的具体职能、核心任务及实际成果，反映组织能力、责任感和团队协作水平。",
    "1-2": "仅提及班委身份，未说明具体职能或任务，成果描述模糊不清，缺乏可验证的实际事例，无法体现组织能力、责任感或团队协作。",
    "3-4": "列举了1-2项班委的基本职能和简单任务，如收发材料、通知信息，成果描述较笼统，如“同学反映良好”，缺少具体数据或详细过程，未能充分展示责任感和团队协作。",
    "5-6": "明确描述了2-3项核心职能及对应任务，如组织班级活动、协调课程安排，并提供了部分实际成果，如“活动参与率达80%”“完成课程协调10次”，能体现一定的组织能力和责任感，但细节深度不足，团队作用未深入展开。",
    "7-8": "详述了3项及以上具体职能与核心任务，如策划主题班会、管理班费支出、带领小组项目，成果描述具体且可验证，如“班会参与率提升至90%”“班费节约15%”“项目获校级奖项”，清晰反映了组织协调、财务管理和团队合作能力。",
    "9-10": "全面覆盖班委的多维度职责，包括日常管理、创新项目、危机处理等，每项任务均配有详尽成果和量化指标，如“成功调解矛盾3起”“创新活动吸引外班参与20人次”，突出展示了高度责任感、卓越组织力和团队领导力。",
    "11-12": "不仅涵盖各项职责与任务，还系统性地总结了长期成效与持续改进机制，如“建立班级档案制度”“实施季度反馈调查”，成果显著且有长期影响，如“班级凝聚力提升”“连续两学期无违纪事件”，充分体现了系统性组织能力、前瞻性规划和团队引领作用。",
    "13-14": "在全面描述基础上，结合个人反思与团队评价，如“同学匿名反馈满意度达95%”“辅导员多次表扬”，成果描述具有高度可信度和多源验证，展现了卓越的领导艺术、深厚的群众基础和持续优化的责任感。",
    "15-16": "通过复杂案例（如大型活动、突发情况）展现综合组织能力，如“紧急处理疫情封控下的物资调配”“跨省联合社会实践”，成果极具影响力且被多方认可，如“获得校内外媒体报道”“被学院推广经验”，体现了超越常规的决策力、应变力和团队协作水平。"
  },
  {
    "name": "马克思主义中国化理解深度",
    "criteria_description": "评价对党的指导思想尤其是马克思主义中国化的理解和收获，需展现独立思考和认知层次。",
    "1-2": "对马克思主义中国化的理解停留在表面，仅能复述基本术语如“毛泽东思想”“中国特色社会主义”，缺乏对理论发展脉络、实践结合点的分析；未体现独立思考或认知层次，收获描述空泛，与个人成长关联薄弱。",
    "3-4": "能简述马克思主义中国化的主要阶段（如新民主主义革命、改革开放），提及部分理论成果（如邓小平理论、“三个代表”重要思想），但解释较机械，未能清晰说明各阶段理论如何回应时代问题；收获部分有简单联系个人经历，但深度不足，独立思考痕迹较少。",
    "5-6": "能系统梳理马克思主义中国化的关键历史节点和理论创新，并尝试分析其背后的社会矛盾与解决路径（如社会主义市场经济体制的建立）；收获部分体现一定反思，能结合专业学习或社会实践，说明理论对自身价值观的塑造，但分析仍显笼统，缺乏具体案例支撑。",
    "7-8": "对马克思主义中国化进程有深入剖析，能精准指出不同时期理论创新的现实基础（如脱贫攻坚与共同富裕）、逻辑演进（如从“发展是硬道理”到高质量发展），并能对比国际共运史中的差异化路径；收获部分展现明确认知跃迁，如通过研读《习近平谈治国理政》形成对国家治理体系的独特见解，且与个人科研方向（如数字经济）产生实质性联结。",
    "9-10": "全面把握马克思主义中国化的理论内核与历史逻辑，能批判性讨论重大理论命题（如新时代社会主要矛盾转化）及其政策映射（如双循环战略）；收获部分呈现高度内化的政治自觉，如通过参与乡村振兴调研提炼出“基层党建+产业扶贫”模式的哲学意义，并主动将经济学研究与国家战略需求结合，提出具有操作性的政策建议。",
    "11-12": "在马克思主义中国化理解上达到学术级深度，能自主构建理论分析框架（如用历史唯物主义解读中国式现代化），并揭示其与西方现代化模式的本质差异；收获部分展现持续的理论探索精神，如通过比较《资本论》与新发展理念，论证马克思主义经济学在中国语境下的创造性转化，且已转化为推动学科建设的实际行动（如发起“红色经济”读书会）。"
  },
  {
    "name": "党组织生活与社会公益活动参与度",
    "criteria_description": "评估参与党组织生活和社会公益活动的频率和角色，体现对集体活动的投入和奉献精神。",
    "1-2": "极少或从未参与党组织生活和社会公益活动，无相关记录或仅有被动出席的简单活动，未承担任何组织角色或实际贡献。",
    "3-4": "偶尔参与党组织生活和社会公益活动，如班级组织的志愿服务或党支部例会，但参与频率较低（每学期1-2次），仅作为普通成员执行基本任务，无主动策划或领导行为。",
    "5-6": "定期参与党组织生活（如每月参加支部会议）和至少一项社会公益活动（如社区帮扶、环保行动等），能完成分配的任务并体现一定主动性；在活动中担任过小组协调员等辅助角色，但未主导过整体项目。",
    "7-8": "积极参与多种类型的党组织生活（如主题党日、学习研讨会）和社会公益活动（如扶贫支教、大型赛会服务），每季度至少参与2次，曾作为负责人或核心成员策划并实施具体活动方案，取得可验证的成果（如服务对象反馈、活动总结报告）。",
    "9-10": "高频次、多样化深度参与党组织生活与社会公益活动（如担任学生党支部委员、公益社团骨干），每季度参与次数超过3次，且多次牵头组织校级或跨院级活动，活动内容涵盖思想教育、民生服务、政策宣传等多个领域，产生显著社会效益（如获得媒体报道、获得表彰证书）。",
    "11-12": "在党组织生活和社会公益活动中发挥模范带头作用，如创立新型公益项目、推动校地合作共建、担任区域青年志愿者联合会职务等，长期（持续一年以上）投入精力并保持卓越表现，形成具有推广价值的案例经验（如获市级以上奖项、被纳入典型经验汇编）。"
  },
  {
    "name": "政治信仰与入党动机真实性",
    "criteria_description": "关注对政治信仰和入党动机的表述是否诚恳真实，避免空泛套话，展示对党的忠诚和决心。",
    "1-2": "表述中存在大量空泛套话，如“坚决拥护党的领导”等，缺乏具体事例支撑政治信仰和入党动机；对党的忠诚和决心仅停留在口号层面，未体现个人真实经历或思想转变过程。",
    "3-4": "提及部分个人经历（如学习、社会实践），但未能深入剖析这些经历如何影响其政治信仰的形成；入党动机描述较为笼统，虽有提到党的指导思想，但未结合自身实际展示深刻理解。",
    "5-6": "能够结合个人经历（如担任班委、参与公益活动）说明其对党的认识逐步加深的过程；有明确的政治信仰表述，并能联系马克思主义中国化的相关内容，但分析尚显浅显，缺乏更深层次的反思。",
    "7-8": "详细阐述个人在学习和生活中如何通过实际行动体现对党的忠诚和支持，如具体的社会公益项目、班级管理成效等；入党动机清晰且真诚，能深入分析马克思主义中国化进程中的关键理论及其现实意义，展现持续的学习态度。",
    "9-10": "不仅全面回顾个人成长轨迹，还系统性地将经济学科背景与国家发展需求相结合，提出切实可行的服务国家策略；政治信仰坚定，入党动机高度内化，通过详实的案例证明其在思想上、行动上的准备充分，展现出强烈的责任感和使命感。",
    "11-12": "在过往经验的基础上，提出具有创新性和前瞻性的观点，如运用经济学知识解决现实问题的具体路径；政治信仰极为坚定，入党动机极其明确，表现出超越同龄人的成熟思考；对党的忠诚和决心体现在每一个细节中，包括日常行为、学术研究和未来规划，全方位展示出高度的真实性和诚意。"
  },
  {
    "name": "经济学科推动国家进步策略可行性",
    "criteria_description": "衡量提出的利用经济学知识服务国家的策略是否具有可操作性和实际意义，体现专业抱负与国家情怀的结合。",
    "1-2": "策略描述模糊，缺乏具体操作步骤和实际应用场景；未体现经济学专业知识与国家需求的有效结合，仅泛泛提及服务国家或社会发展，无明确目标、路径或预期效果。",
    "3-4": "提出部分可操作的经济学科相关措施，但实施细节不足，如缺少具体行业、政策领域或技术工具支持；对国家进步的贡献方向较笼统，未能清晰论证其可行性或潜在影响，专业抱负与国家情怀联系较弱。",
    "5-6": "策略具备一定可执行性，包含明确的政策建议（如乡村振兴、数字经济）、研究工具（计量模型、数据分析）或实践平台（校企合作、智库项目），并能说明其在特定领域的应用价值；能结合马克思主义中国化理论阐述策略背景，但深度有限。",
    "7-8": "提出多维度、分阶段的实施路径，涵盖短期试点方案与长期制度设计，如建立基层调研机制、推动绿色金融产品创新等；详细论证所选经济领域与国家战略（如双碳目标、区域协调发展）的契合点，体现系统性思考和专业能力支撑。",
    "9-10": "策略高度聚焦国家重大需求，提出原创性、前沿性的解决方案（如基于大数据的价格调控机制、普惠金融推广模式），并辅以详实数据、案例或前期研究成果证明其可行性；深度结合马克思主义中国化最新成果，展现强烈的家国情怀与社会责任感。",
    "11-12": "构建完整闭环体系，包括问题诊断、方案设计、资源动员、效果评估等环节，且每环节均体现经济学专业方法（如成本收益分析、博弈论建模）；策略具有显著推广潜力，可直接对接政府决策流程或企业社会责任项目，彰显卓越领导力与使命担当。"
  },
  {
    "name": "恳切措辞与情感表达强度",
    "criteria_description": "评估申请书的情感表达是否恳切，语言是否真诚且具感染力，体现申请者的态度和内在动机。",
    "1-2": "情感表达极为薄弱，语言机械生硬，仅罗列事实而无个人态度或动机体现。例如，使用纯客观陈述描述经历，未尝试传达任何对党的认同感、向往或内在驱动力。",
    "3-4": "有基本的情感尝试但流于表面，措辞较为公式化，缺乏真诚性和感染力。例如，套用常见入党申请书模板语句，仅在结尾提及“恳请党组织考察”等固定表达，中间部分未展现个性化情感投入。",
    "5-6": "情感表达初步显现，能结合具体事例体现一定真诚性，如简述某次活动后的感受，但仍以叙述为主，感染力有限。能识别出申请者试图表达态度，但深度和频率不足，多数段落仍以信息堆砌为主。",
    "7-8": "情感表达明确且自然融入各部分内容，通过细节描写（如学习理论时的思想转变、公益活动中的亲身感悟）展现真诚态度与内在动机。语言有一定个性化特征，避免完全模板化，使读者能感受到申请者的真实情感波动。",
    "9-10": "情感表达高度恳切且贯穿全文，语言充满真诚、热情与个人色彩，能持续引发共鸣。例如，在阐述个人经历时频繁穿插内心独白、思想斗争或成长反思，展现强烈的政治信仰和情感依附，感染力极强。",
    "11-12": "情感表达卓越，不仅诚恳真挚，更通过独特视角和深刻思考升华整体内容。例如，将经济学科与国家发展紧密结合时，体现出强烈责任感和使命感；对党的理解超越表层，展现出深刻的自我认知与价值追求，情感具有高度穿透力和持久影响力。"
  },
  {
    "name": "理论联系实际能力展现",
    "criteria_description": "评估能否将党的理论与个人实际经历结合，展示学以致用的能力，增强说服力。",
    "1-2": "未能有效结合党的理论与个人经历，仅简单罗列个人学历、班委经历或公益活动，缺乏对理论如何指导实践的具体描述；马克思主义中国化相关内容与个人行动无明确关联。",
    "3-4": "初步尝试将党的理论与个人部分经历结合，如提及马克思主义中国化时列举1-2个学习收获，但未深入说明如何转化为实际行动；班委或公益活动描述中仅有一处体现理论指导实践的痕迹，整体结合较为生硬。",
    "5-6": "能够清晰关联党的理论与个人经历，如详细阐述马克思主义中国化某一阶段的学习对其担任班委决策的影响，或说明经济学科策略如何源于党的理论指导；结合点至少覆盖2个主要经历（如班委、公益），但个别部分的联系深度不足。",
    "7-8": "在多个关键经历中自然融入党的理论应用，如奖学金获取体现“创新驱动发展”理念，班委任务达成效果反映“群众路线”实践，公益活动展现“社会责任”意识；马克思主义中国化理解与经济学科策略形成逻辑闭环，学以致用痕迹明显。",
    "9-10": "全面且有机地融合党的理论与个人实际，所有经历（学历、班委、公益等）均体现理论指导下的主动选择，如通过“新发展理念”设计班级经济调研项目；马克思主义中国化进程分析能精准对应个人成长节点，提出基于经济专业的国家进步方案，说服力极强。",
    "11-12": "理论联系实际能力卓越，不仅贯穿所有经历，还展现创新性应用，如用“供给侧结构性改革”思维优化班费管理流程，或基于“共同富裕”目标发起经济类公益项目；对马克思主义中国化的理解深度超越课本，形成个人独特见解并反哺实践，案例典型且可推广。"
  }

system: 帮我写一封考研前给高中英语老师的生日祝福信，字数控制在300字左右,语言要温馨感人 ，可以适当融入一两句与英语或文学相关的优美句子
solution:
[
  {
    "name": "情感真挚度与个性化回忆",
    "criteria_description": "评估信件是否通过具体事例、细腻描写和真诚表达传达真实感人的情感，并包含独特的个人经历或回忆，避免泛泛而谈。检查点：是否有具体事件、场景或个人感悟支撑情感表达。",
    "1-2": "信件缺乏具体事例或场景描写，情感表达泛泛而谈，未体现与老师的独特回忆或个人感悟，仅使用通用祝福语。",
    "3-4": "信件包含一个简单事件或场景的提及（如课堂片段），但描写较为笼统，情感表达有一定尝试但未深入细节，缺乏细腻的文学语言或个性化英语相关引用。",
    "5-6": "信件通过一个具体事例（如某次课后辅导）支撑情感表达，描述较清晰且有一定细节（如时间、地点、对话片段），尝试融入一句与英语/文学相关的句子但未完全贴合情境。",
    "7-8": "信件包含至少两个具体事例或场景（如老师鼓励+共同阅读经历），描写细腻生动（如环境、动作、情绪变化），并自然嵌入一句与英语/文学相关的优美句子，情感真挚且有个人独特性。",
    "9-10": "信件通过多个高度具体的事件（如考研压力下的指导、生日当天的惊喜）和感官细节（如声音、画面、触感）构建沉浸式回忆，文学化语言流畅且与情境高度契合，情感深刻且充满个性化表达。",
    "11-12": "信件以连贯的叙事逻辑串联多个独特回忆（如从高中到考研的时间线），细节描写极具画面感和情感张力（如老师批改笔记的特写），巧妙融合多句英语/文学引用且完全服务于个人情感，整体呈现高度真挚、原创性和艺术性。"
  },
  {
    "name": "师生关系体现与教育价值",
    "criteria_description": "评估信件是否突出高中英语老师与考研学生的独特关系，并体现老师教育对学生的影响。检查点：是否有关于课堂互动、老师帮助或鼓励的回忆，以及教学方法或态度影响的描述。",
    "1-2": "信件中未提及任何与高中英语老师的互动或回忆，也没有体现老师对学生的帮助、鼓励或教学方法的影响，完全缺乏师生关系和教育价值的描述。",
    "3-4": "信件中仅简单提到老师的名字和学科，但缺乏具体细节描述课堂互动、帮助或鼓励，教育价值体现模糊且未具体说明老师对学生的影响。",
    "5-6": "信件中有提及一到两个课堂互动或老师帮助学生的小例子，但描述较为简略，未充分展开；教育价值有所体现，但影响描述不够深入。",
    "7-8": "信件中详细描述了多个课堂互动、老师帮助或鼓励的具体事例，并明确提及这些事例对学生的影响；教育价值通过教学方法或态度影响的描述得到较好体现。",
    "9-10": "信件中生动详实地描绘了多个课堂互动、老师帮助或鼓励的深刻回忆，事例具体且情感真挚；教育价值不仅体现在描述中，还深入探讨了这些经历对学生考研及人生的长远影响。",
    "11-12": "信件中全面细致地展现了师生间的独特关系，包括丰富的课堂互动、个性化帮助和鼓励，事例极具代表性且感人至深；教育价值通过多角度、多层次的描述得到充分体现，深刻展示了老师教育对学生思想、行为和价值观的深远影响。"
  },
  {
    "name": "语言温馨感人与语气一致性",
    "criteria_description": "评估语言风格是否温暖亲切，符合生日祝福氛围，且整封信语气一致。检查点：是否有柔和词汇、非生硬表达，以及无突然转变的语气或风格不一致。",
    "1-2": "语言风格冷淡或机械，使用大量生硬词汇和正式表达，缺乏柔和感；语气在祝福与陈述间频繁切换，风格明显不一致，未能营造生日祝福所需的温暖氛围。",
    "3-4": "语言基本礼貌但偏向中性，部分柔和词汇出现但不连贯，存在少量生硬表达；整体语气大致统一，但偶有突然转折或风格偏移，温馨感人效果有限。",
    "5-6": "多数表达采用柔和、亲切的词汇（如“您”“陪伴”“感恩”），句式自然流畅，无明显生硬痕迹；语气整体一致，围绕生日祝福展开，未出现突兀风格变化，能传递基本温暖感。",

  {

    "1-2": "信中未使用任何英语词汇、短语或文学名句，或所引用的元素与上下文完全脱节，显得生硬且破坏整体情感表达。",

  {

    "7-8": "信件结构清晰（有明确的开头、主体和结尾），主体内容紧密围绕生日祝福，逻辑流畅，仅包含少量与英语或文学相关的适当点缀。",

  {

    "7-8": "清晰描述考研时间节点及备考状态，体现个人努力与目标；对过去有具体感谢内容（如某次辅导、鼓励），对未来有明确期许（如考试目标、人生规划）。",

    "13-14": "卓越呈现考研与备考的细节，展现个人独特经历与心理变化；对过去有丰富、感人的回忆（多事件、多角度），对未来有宏大、充满希望的展望（全球视野、人类关怀等）。"

  {
    "name": "祝福语创意与祝福深度",
    "criteria_description": "评估祝福语是否有新意且深入，不仅是表面祝愿。检查点：是否有独特表达方式或创新的祝福内容，以及对老师未来生活、健康的深层祝福。",
    "1-2": "祝福语仅包含基本的生日祝贺，如“生日快乐”“身体健康”等常见表达，无独特或创新之处，未涉及老师的未来生活或健康深层祝福。",
    "3-4": "祝福语中尝试使用一两种创新表达方式，但新意有限，主要停留在表面祝愿，未能深入探讨老师未来生活、健康或其他深层次内容。",
    "5-6": "祝福语中有明确的创新点，比如结合英语或文学元素的独特表达，但对老师未来生活、健康的深层祝福较少，仅有一两句提及。",
    "7-8": "祝福语包含多个创新表达方式，如引用英语或文学中的优美句子，并明确提及老师的未来生活、健康等至少一个方面的深层祝福，但未完全展开。",
    "9-10": "祝福语中有显著的创新和独特性，如巧妙融入多句英语或文学元素，对老师的未来生活、健康等方面有多层次的深入祝福，且表达自然流畅。",
    "11-12": "祝福语在创新性和深度上均表现突出，如通过独特的文学手法或个性化语言表达对老师的深厚情感，全面且具体地涵盖未来生活、健康等多维度祝福，情感真挚感人。"

    "1-2": "字数严重偏离要求（少于270或超过330），且全文几乎完全使用模板化语句，无任何个性化表达，语言机械生硬。",

system: 请帮我起草一份设备采购合同纠纷的民事起诉状，需严格按照民事诉讼状的法定格式撰写，请重点阐述违约事实、法律依据以及具体赔偿计算方式。具体情况是：我作为需方于2024年2月与供方刘某签订了采购协议，支付了12万元预付款，约定3月5日前交付设备。但供方收款后以原材料短缺为由拒绝履行义务。
solution:
[
  {
    "name": "民事起诉状格式规范性",
    "criteria_description": "必须严格符合民事诉讼状的法定结构，包括首部（原被告信息、案由）、正文（诉讼请求、事实与理由）、尾部（管辖法院、具状人签章等），缺一不可，否则将导致立案障碍。",
    "1-2": "缺少法定结构中的多个关键部分，如首部（原被告信息、案由）、正文（诉讼请求、事实与理由）或尾部（管辖法院、具状人签章等），导致无法完成立案基本要求。",
    "3-4": "包含大部分法定结构，但存在以下问题之一：首部信息不完整（如案由缺失）、正文中诉讼请求不明确或事实与理由描述模糊、尾部缺少管辖法院或具状人签章。",
    "5-6": "基本符合法定结构，各部分齐全，但细节上有所欠缺。例如：首部信息完整但案由表述不够规范；正文中诉讼请求明确，但事实与理由未充分引用法律依据；尾部有管辖法院和具状人签章，但签章位置或格式不规范。",
    "7-8": "严格符合法定结构且细节完善。首部包含完整原被告信息及规范案由；正文中诉讼请求清晰具体，事实与理由详实并准确引用相关法律条款，赔偿计算方式明确合理；尾部明确管辖法院，具状人签章格式规范，无遗漏。",
    "9-10": "完全符合法定结构并在细节上卓越。首部信息详尽且案由表述高度专业；正文中诉讼请求层次分明，事实与理由逻辑严密，法律依据引用精准，赔偿计算方式详细且有支撑材料说明；尾部管辖法院选择正确，具状人签章完整且格式无可挑剔。",
    "11-12": "超出法定要求，展现出卓越的专业性。除上述所有要素外，还包含其他增强文件说服力的元素，如证据清单与起诉状对应明确、对可能抗辩点的预先反驳、引用的判例支持、以及文书整体排版美观易读。"
  },
  {
    "name": "违约事实陈述完整性",
    "criteria_description": "需明确供方收款时间（2024年2月）、预付款金额（12万元）、约定交货日（3月5日）、拒绝履约行为（原材料短缺理由）等关键事实，确保构成完整违约链条。",
    "1-2": "仅提及部分关键事实（如预付款金额或约定交货日），但缺失供方收款时间、拒绝履约行为等核心要素，违约链条存在明显断裂。",
    "3-4": "包含预付款金额（12万元）、约定交货日（3月5日）和拒绝履约行为（原材料短缺理由），但未明确供方收款时间为2024年2月，导致违约时间线不完整。",
    "5-6": "明确列出供方收款时间（2024年2月）、预付款金额（12万元）、约定交货日（3月5日）和拒绝履约行为（原材料短缺理由），形成基本完整的违约事实链条，但未对拒绝履约行为的细节进行补充说明（如是否书面通知或沟通记录）。",
    "7-8": "清晰陈述所有关键事实（收款时间、金额、交货日、拒绝履约行为），并补充了拒绝履约的具体方式（如微信通知、邮件告知等证据形式），且通过逻辑连接词（如“因”“遂”）强化因果关系，违约链条严密无漏洞。",
    "9-10": "在7-8分基础上，进一步细化违约行为的时间节点（如“2024年3月6日明确表示无法交货”）、补充合同条款引用（如“违反协议第X条交货义务”），并通过法律术语（如“单方毁约”“根本违约”）提升事实与法律依据的衔接紧密度。",
    "11-12": "在9-10分基础上，额外提供客观证据指向（如“见转账凭证编号XX”“参见附件聊天记录截图”），确保每个事实均可交叉验证，且通过数据对比（如“预付款占比合同总价XX%”）强化违约严重性，构成无可争议的完整举证体系。"
  },
  {
    "name": "法律依据准确性",
    "criteria_description": "必须引用《民法典》合同编中关于违约责任的具体条款（如第577条、第584条），并准确对应本案事实，避免引用错误法条或泛泛而谈“合同法”。",
    "1-2": "未引用《民法典》合同编具体条款，或仅泛泛提及“合同法”“违约责任”等无具体条文号；或引用法条与本案事实无关（如引用非违约责任条款）。",
    "3-4": "引用了《民法典》合同编部分条款（如第577条），但遗漏关键条款（如第584条）；或虽列出多条但未明确说明各条款与本案事实的对应关系，仅罗列法条。",
    "5-6": "引用了《民法典》第577条和第584条，基本准确对应违约行为与损失赔偿范围；但未详细说明如何结合案件事实（如预付款性质、原材料短缺是否构成正当理由）进行法律适用分析。",
    "7-8": "引用《民法典》第577条和第584条，并清晰逐项说明其与案件事实的对应关系（如第577条对应“拒绝履行义务”，第584条对应“预付款利息及可得利益损失”）；能区分条款的适用层次（实际损失 vs 预期利益）。",
    "9-10": "完整引用《民法典》第577条、第584条及其他相关条文（如第588条关于定金/预付款处理），系统分析条款之间的逻辑关联；对争议点（如“原材料短缺是否免责”）进行针对性法律解释，排除错误抗辩。",
    "11-12": "除上述要求外，能指出本案特殊情形下的法律适用细节（如预付款是否转化为定金、可得利益损失的举证标准），并结合司法实践提出合理主张，体现对违约责任体系的深度把握。"
  },
  {
    "name": "赔偿计算逻辑清晰度",
    "criteria_description": "需分项列出预付款返还、利息损失（按LPR计算）、其他实际损失（如替代采购差价）等，每项需有明确计算公式和依据，体现可执行性。",
    "1-2": "仅提及预付款返还，未涉及利息损失和其他实际损失的计算，缺乏具体计算公式和依据。",
    "3-4": "列出预付款返还和利息损失（按LPR计算），但其他实际损失如替代采购差价等未提及或描述不明确，公式和依据不够详细。",
    "5-6": "包括预付款返还、利息损失（按LPR计算）、其他实际损失（如替代采购差价）等主要项目，每个项目有基本的计算公式和依据，但某些细节如利率的具体取值或替代采购的参照标准不够明确。",
    "7-8": "全面涵盖预付款返还、利息损失（按LPR计算，注明具体利率和时间段）、其他实际损失（如替代采购差价，注明参照标准和采购渠道），每项均有详细的计算公式和依据，并说明数据来源及合理性。",
    "9-10": "在7-8的基础上，对每项损失的计算公式进行严格论证，例如LPR利率选取的时间点、替代采购差价的公允性验证方法，以及所有数据的出处和交叉验证，体现出高度的可执行性和法律严谨性。",
    "11-12": "在9-10的基础上，补充了可能存在的特殊情况处理方案，如供方提出异议时的应对措施，以及赔偿计算的动态调整机制，确保整个逻辑体系无漏洞且具备实际操作弹性。",
    "13-14": "在11-12的基础上，进一步细化到每一笔款项的时间节点、金额变动记录、相关证据材料清单，并附上类似案例的司法实践支持，使得整个赔偿计算逻辑既严密又具有高度说服力。"
  },

Supplementary introduction for an academic paper focusing on sustainable consumption and textile waste valorization, necessitating a thorough analysis from both ecological and commercial viewpoints, highlighting its critical role within the broader paradigm of a green transition. Detailed specifications are as follows: 1. The introductory section must exceed 1,100 words in length; 2. The prose should adopt a formal, scholarly tone, employing precise terminology and structured argumentation, targeting academics and professionals reading literature reviews on sustainable consumption and textile waste management; 3. The introduction must articulate the contextual background and research aims with clarity, proposing linkage to contemporary global challenges, for instance, addressing biodiversity loss, pollution, and associated real-world dilemmas, supplemented with trend information concerning ecosystem degradation, material overuse, and green economic growth; 4. During analysis, incorporate relevant quantitative figures from reputable organizations on the ecological and fiscal consequences of textile waste to strengthen argument validity; 5. Integrate exemplary global instances of innovative business models or regulatory frameworks, or effective practices in textile upcycling as corroborative evidence. The general demeanor should be polished and expert. Reference framework: Literature Review on Sustainable Consumption and Textile Valorization:

I. Foundations and Principles of Sustainable Consumption
1. Theoretical Evolution and Conceptual Milestones
2. Core Tenets and Operational Definitions

II. International Advancements in Sustainable Consumption Theory
1. Product-Level Strategies (Corporate Initiatives)
(1) Cradle-to-Cradle Design Philosophy
(2) Material Flow Analysis (MFA) Methodology
2. Sector-Level Integration (Industry-Wide Networks)
(1) Collaborative Consumption Models
(2) Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) Systems
3. Societal-Level Transformation (Systemic Change)
(1) Sufficiency Economy Principles
(2) Performance Economy Theory

III. Progression of Sustainable Consumption in the European Context

IV. Applied Implementations of Sustainable Consumption Theory

Bibliographical Sources:
[1] Tim Jackson. Prosperity Without Growth: Foundations for the Economy of Tomorrow [M]. London: Routledge, 2017.
[2] Kate Raworth. Doughnut Economics: Seven Ways to Think Like a 21st-Century Economist [M]. London: Random House Business, 2017.
[3] Walter R. Stahel. The Performance Economy: Business Models for the Functional Service Economy [M]. London: Palgrave Macmillan, 2010.
[4] John Elkington. Cannibals with Forks: The Triple Bottom Line of 21st Century Business [M]. Oxford: Capstone Publishing, 1997.
[5] Naomi Klein. This Changes Everything: Capitalism vs. The Climate [M]. New York: Simon & Schuster, 2014.
[6] Michael Braungart & William McDonough. Cradle to Cradle: Remaking the Way We Make Things [M]. New York: North Point Press, 2002.
[7] Juliet Schor. Plenitude: The New Economics of True Wealth [M]. New York: Penguin Press, 2010.
[8] European Environment Agency. The European Environment – State and Outlook 2020 [M]. Luxembourg: Publications Office of the European Union, 2019.

Quantitative Metrics on Ecological and Commercial Impact of Textile Waste from Recognized Bodies:

Globally, the fashion and textile sector is a significant contributor to resource depletion and pollution. Annually, an estimated 92 million tonnes of textile waste is generated. Less than 1% of material used to produce clothing is recycled into new garments, leading to a linear economic loss valued at over $500 billion per year. The industry is responsible for about 10% of global carbon emissions and is a major consumer of water, with cotton cultivation alone using approximately 2,700 liters of water for a single t-shirt.

Post-consumer textile waste in the EU-27 amounts to roughly 5.8 million tonnes per year, with only 1.5-2 million tonnes being separately collected for reuse or recycling. The landfilling and incineration of textiles represent a substantial loss of valuable fibers and contribute to greenhouse gas emissions and soil contamination.

The global market for textile recycling and circular fashion was valued at around $6.5 billion in 2022 and is projected to grow significantly, driven by regulatory pressure and consumer awareness. Investment in circular textile startups has seen a marked increase, focusing on mechanical recycling, chemical fiber-to-fiber processes, and digital platforms for resale.

Source: Ellen MacArthur Foundation Reports, European Environment Agency Data, and Market Research Futures Analysis.

以宋代士大夫的交往圈为舞台，创作一部浸润文化深意的诗意小说，主线聚焦于知己情谊与立场反目的戏剧冲突。作品须刻画儒生群体的灵魂对话与伦理挣扎，折射两宋独特的人文气象。行文当古雅隽永，嵌入词牌格律或经典辞藻，面向古典文学受众。小说体量约8000-10000字，符合短篇发表规格。需糅合真实历史切片，如南宋临安的文化图景，但核心为虚构传奇。对主人公（士林精英）展开深度心理描摹，展现在信义崩塌时的撕裂感，追求苍凉美感与情感穿透力。

宋代文艺脉络相关参引素材，如该朝代的礼乐风尚、词学流变、史实掌故等：
    宋代文艺的底色与辐射
    两宋时期孕育了中国文化的高峰状态，士大夫阶层通过文艺实践构筑精神家园。词曲书画等艺术形态不仅承载时代心绪，更对东亚文明产生轴心式影响。本文解析宋代文艺的生成语境及其跨时空涟漪效应。
    一、生态背景
    北宋汴梁与南宋临安构成双城记，工商业勃兴催生市民审美，而外患压力反向激发文化内省。科举体系塑造知识共同体，禅宗思想渗透艺术创作，形成"雅俗共赏"的特质。
    二、影响力场
    1.制度遗产：书院网络促成学术平民化，《百家姓》《三字经》启蒙教材流传千年。
    2.美学革命：米芾"墨戏"开创写意先河，宋瓷单色釉确立极简美学范式。
    3.心灵图谱：程朱理学构建道德宇宙观，文人通过咏物词实现生命观照。
    4.社会镜像：《清明上河图》全景记录市井生态，话本小说揭露吏治积弊。

南宋民俗图志：
一、科举生态链
三年大比牵动全国神经，贡院放榜日万人空巷。落第者结"同年社"相互慰藉，及第者跨马游街接受"榜下捉婿"。
二、瓦舍勾栏文化
临安二十余处瓦舍昼夜不休，说书人演绎《中兴名将传》，杂剧艺人编排《目连救母》，市民与士子共享文化盛宴。
三、茶禅日常
斗茶之风盛行，僧俗在龙井草堂举行"分茶会"，以茶筅击拂乳花作画，苏轼创制"波浪纹"点茶法载入《茶录》。

宋词美学体系：
  词学在姜夔手中完成音乐文学化进程，《白石道人歌曲》十七首旁缀工尺谱。吴文英创四声守律派，张炎提出"清空说"。汴京沦陷后，辛弃疾以剑器入词，李清照用双溪舴艋舟意象传递亡国之恸，形成沉郁顿挫的南渡词风。

士林轶闻辑录：
    一、东坡雪堂悟道
    苏轼贬居黄州时，于东坡垦荒筑雪堂。与陈慥书信往来中发明"呵呵"叠字，在《寒食帖》真迹里藏匿政治隐喻，展现困境中的精神超越。
    二、陆唐词坛双璧
    陆游与唐婉沈园重逢题《钗头凤》，五十载后陆游作"伤心桥下春波绿"，见证痴情与礼教的对峙撕扯。
    三、朱熹弹劾唐仲友
    浙东提举朱熹六疏弹劾台州知州唐仲友，严蕊受牵连遭刑讯时赋词自辩："不是爱风尘，似被前缘误"，揭开道学家的温情面具。
    四、文天祥囚室正气
    大都狱中，文天祥以"鼎镬甘如饴"回应劝降，狱卒偷传其《正气歌》抄本，成就士节不朽丰碑。
    五、周密辑录武林旧事
    遗民周密隐居杭州癸辛街，著《武林旧事》追忆临安繁华，在梨园故伎重演《霓裳》时痛哭失声，完成文化记忆的临终抢救。

  说起力学，有人或许疑惑它究竟是什么？大家常觉得力学属于物理，因为中学物理课首章就涉及它。但进入高等教育后，有人会问：既然有物理专业，为何还设力学系？通过系统学习，尤其在李教授深入浅出的讲解中，我们认识到力学不仅是物理的分支，更是探索物体运动与相互作用规律的科学，其知识源于古代对自然和劳动工具的观察，如人们在搬运、耕作中运用轮轴、滑轮等设备，逐步形成对力与平衡的认知，可见力学紧密联系着日常。那么，在深入前，先瞧瞧生活中司空见惯却蕴含力学原理的现象。  
平常你可曾留意以下情境：  
1.溜冰鞋，冰刀设计得锋利狭窄  
2.乘地铁时，加速启动瞬间身体向后仰  
3.风筝能在侧风中稳定翱翔  
4.悬挂重物于弹簧，松手后它会上下振动  
5.开瓶器利用螺旋省力  
这些例子虽简单，但细心观察能发现更多趣味。下面我们一起看看历史上的一些事件。  
  2001年9月11日，美国世贸中心双子塔遭撞击后倒塌，调查指出除了恐怖袭击，建筑结构的力学性能不足是关键因素，钢材在高温下强度剧降，导致支撑失效。这警示我们材料力学在安全设计中的重要性。  
另一起事故是2005年8月29日，日本新干线列车在行驶中脱轨，造成107人受伤。事后分析发现，轨道接缝处的疲劳裂纹在长期载荷下扩展，引发力学上的脆性断裂，促使列车失控。如今铁路维护中频繁检测就是为了预防此类问题。  
还有2013年4月24日，孟加拉国拉纳广场服装厂大楼坍塌，1127人死亡。根源在于违规加建楼层，超出地基力学承载极限，加上建材劣质，酿成惨剧。这凸显了工程力学在规范施工中的核心作用。  
灾难之外，力学也推动进步。例如，现代汽车防撞系统基于碰撞力学，通过 crumple zone 吸收冲击能，保护乘员；体育中，标枪投掷依赖空气动力学优化飞行距离。  
在科技领域，力学贡献卓著。太空探索依赖轨道力学精确计算探测器路径；医疗设备如心脏支架，运用固体力学确保血管支撑。此外，风力发电叶片设计借助流体力学提升效率。  
环境方面，力学助力生态保护。例如，城市规划中利用扩散模型模拟污染物传播，通过调整工厂布局减少空气污染；水处理工程依据流体力学净化水源。  
经济波动也可用力学类比。比如，市场泡沫如同弹簧压缩，积累势能后突然释放；宏观调控类似增加系统阻尼，抑制振荡。  
总之，力学是一门既古老又现代的科学，它从自然现象中提炼规律，并应用于工程、生活乃至社会领域。掌握力学，能帮助我们更好理解世界、创新技术、规避风险。正如一句格言所言：“力学者，万物动变之钥”，其根本价值在于服务人类福祉。

As the director of a TAL Education training center, I need to design a promotional copy for a winter coding camp. Requirements: 1) The text should be approximately 400-500 words; 2) Must emphasize our elite instructor team (all hold degrees in computer science from top-tier universities with minimum 6 years of teaching experience) and our students' outstanding performance in national youth programming competitions; 3) The tone should be warm and inspiring, tailored for parent audiences, projecting an image of expertise and reliability; 4) The copy structure must contain these parts: Opening hook (stressing the value of computational thinking), detailed course highlights, instructor qualifications presentation, student success stories, early-bird discount information, and enrollment procedure. The goal is to capture parents' interest and drive sign-up consultations.

For detailed instructor profiles, specific pedagogical approaches and course uniqueness, center address and contact details, please see: Chen Xi
Subjects: Primary/Junior High School Programming (Scratch/Python)
Teaching Experience: 11 years

Holds a Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence from Tsinghua University, currently serves as the Lead Curriculum Designer for TAL's "Future Coder" program. Possesses 11 years of teaching experience and 9 years of competition coaching. Her students have consistently won top awards in the National Youth Programming Innovation Challenge; many have been admitted to elite middle schools through tech specialties. Teacher Chen's "project-driven learning" approach and her engaging, clear instructional style are highly praised by students and parents.

Wang Zhijie
Subject: High School Algorithm & Data Structures
Teaching Experience: 8 years

Six years of deep experience in informatics Olympiad training, has led intensive classes aimed at national contest medals, mentoring over 300 students, with 189 achieving perfect scores in provincial algorithm competitions. Specializes in deconstructing complex algorithmic problems and creating learning frameworks. Developed the "Modular Problem-Solving" methodology (enabling students to decompose and reconstruct any coding challenge), helping learners quickly grasp problem essence. Aims to instill the most efficient computational thinking patterns through interactive project-based learning.

Core programming teaching methodologies include:
1. Conceptual mapping: Begin by systematically reviewing and mapping core programming concepts, including syntax rules and algorithmic paradigms from each module. It's advised to maintain a digital concept map for quick revision and connection of ideas.
2. Computational thinking cultivation: Programming education focuses on developing students' computational thinking. Incorporate daily practice with algorithmic puzzles and debugging challenges, such as logic flow exercises and code optimization tasks, to enhance analytical and systematic problem-solving skills.
3. Project decomposition strategy: Tackling complex coding projects requires breaking them down. The strategy is to first comprehend the project scope, define core objectives, then modularize the problem, identify input-output requirements, and finally implement, test, and iterate the solution.
4. Innovative application: Real-world application and innovative project design are crucial in programming education. Encourage participation in hackathons and building practical tools to foster creative application of skills to solve authentic problems.

Key features of our programming camp are:
1. Emphasis on process over output: Stresses understanding the development process and logical flow rather than merely writing correct code. Students learn through iterative design, debugging, and refinement.
2. Theory-practice integration: Uses tangible projects and real-world scenarios to ground abstract concepts, developing practical implementation skills through hands-on creation.
3. Scaffolded learning progression: Requires building knowledge step-by-step, avoiding skipping fundamentals. Instructors provide structured guidance, gradually increasing complexity to prevent frustration and maintain engagement.
4. Collaborative learning environment: Classes employ diverse interactive formats, such as pair programming, code reviews, and team projects, to foster peer learning, communication skills, and a supportive community.

Address: 15th Floor, Tower B, 88 Wangjing Street, Chaoyang District, Beijing
Phone: 010-85769000

根据提供的学生在实验课程中的操作表现：
学生的实验表现具体数据或事实：                                                                                                                                                                                                                              学生在实验中完成的具体操作：                                                                                                                                                                                                                             1、将氦氖激光器接入稳压电源，调节输出功率至稳定状态，确保光束与光学导轨平行。安装双缝组件，仔细校准狭缝方向与光束垂直。

2、调整接收屏与双缝距离至合适位置，使用放大镜观察干涉条纹，调节焦距使条纹清晰。用游标卡尺测量中央亮纹宽度。

3、记录不同缝间距和光源波长下的条纹分布，拍摄高清图像并标注关键参数。

4、测量第k级暗纹到中心线的距离，结合双缝公式计算光波波长，重复五次取平均值。

5、分析环境因素如空气流动和温度变化对条纹稳定性的影响，提出控制方案。

6、设计对比实验，验证干涉现象与缝宽、缝距的理论关系，并撰写初步报告。                                                                                                                                                         是否有创新点：通过基础光学设备直观演示波动光学原理，将抽象概念转化为可量化数据，并引入误差分析以提升实验严谨性                                                         遇到问题时的解决方法：                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1.　干涉图样模糊或不出现。可能原因包括激光束未对准、双缝板有灰尘或环境光过强。
(1)检查激光器镜片清洁度，用专用擦拭布清除污渍，确保光束质量。
(2)在完全黑暗环境中操作，使用遮光罩屏蔽杂散光，必要时更换更亮激光源。
(3)重新安装双缝板，用水平仪调整光学平台，保证各元件共轴对齐。

2.　测量数据波动大。可能源于仪器读数误差、实验台振动或人为操作不一致。
(1)采用数字显微镜替代传统目镜，提高距离测量精度，减少视差影响。
(2)加固光学平台防震脚，关闭实验室通风设备以最小化空气扰动。
(3)标准化操作流程，由同一学生多次独立测量，使用统计软件处理异常值。

3.　理论计算与实测偏差显著。需检查公式适用条件和参数输入准确性。
(1)复习双缝干涉理论，确认缝距、屏距测量方法无误，避免单位换算错误。
(2)校准所有测量工具，如用标准波长光源验证系统误差，并记录校准数据。
(3)引入补偿因子修正环境折射率变化，参考文献调整计算公式。
%
4.　实验效率低下。优化步骤以节省时间并提高可重复性。
(1)预先设置好光学元件位置模板，减少每次实验的调整时间，使用快速夹持装置。
(2)编写自动化数据采集脚本，通过传感器实时记录条纹位置，减少手动记录错误。
(3)组织小组讨论，分享最佳实践，如如何快速识别条纹级次和避免疲劳误差。                                                                                                                                                                                                                  成果：                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1. 成功观察到清晰且稳定的干涉条纹，验证了光的波动性基本原理。  2. 计算得到的光波波长与标准值误差小于5%，证实了实验方法的可靠性。  3. 通过对比不同缝宽实验，发现了条纹间距与缝宽的反比关系，与理论预测一致。 4. 提出了使用偏振片消除杂散光的改进方案，提升了图像对比度。  5. 在实验报告中，详细分析了温度波动对测量结果的影响，并给出了修正建议。  6. 设计了一个拓展实验，用白光光源演示彩色干涉条纹，加深了对波长依赖性的理解。 7. 通过团队协作，优化了数据记录表格，使得后续分析更高效。  8. 利用仿真软件预演实验过程，减少了实际操作中的试错次数。  9. 在课堂展示中，用动画辅助解释干涉原理，获得了同学和教师的好评。  10. 结合历史实验数据，指出了本装置在精度上的局限，并建议未来升级为数字全息系统。
结合学生的实践动手能力，撰写一段具体的评语。请在评语中体现出学生的操作水平、思路清晰度、解决问题的能力以及自主探索的态度等。此外，请结合评语使用者的身份（如教师、家长等）和具体场景需求（如期末评价、鼓励信等）进行更有针对性的表达。如果有可能，还可结合学生的历史表现或成长变化趋势进行分析和评价，以提升评语的个性化和深度。需突出评语的正向激励作用，同时能够明确指出改善或提升方向（如存在）。

It is a key event in the period of the Northern and Southern Dynasties and was pivotal in preventing the unification of China under Former Qin.

Fu Jian, the emperor of Former Qin, led an army of over 800,000 troops southward to conquer Eastern Jin. Eastern Jin, under the leadership of Xie An and Xie Xuan, mustered a force of about 80,000 to defend. The battle took place at the Feishui River. Xie Xuan proposed a tactical retreat to lure the enemy into a disadvantageous position. As the Former Qin troops attempted to cross the river, the Jin forces launched a sudden attack, causing panic and confusion among the Qin soldiers. The retreat order was misinterpreted, leading to a chaotic rout where the Qin army suffered heavy losses, with tales of soldiers hearing the wind and seeing grass as enemy troops.

The Battle of Feishui, where Eastern Jin successfully defended against a much larger invasion, highlighted the effectiveness of psychological warfare and strategic deception, creating a renowned example in Chinese military history of intelligence overcoming brute force. 反应式：6CO₂ + 6H₂O + 光 → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂  

2. 免疫应答 - 身体的防御战  
病原体入侵时，白细胞识别并消灭威胁，如伤口发炎或疫苗接种反应。  
过程涉及抗体抗原特异性结合。  

3. 神经传导 - 电信号的速递  
神经元通过离子交换传递冲动，控制肌肉收缩或感官反应，诠释反射弧机制。  
原理基于动作电位传播。  

4. 发酵工艺 - 微生物的创造力  
酵母转化糖分为乙醇和气体，应用于酸奶发酵或面包膨松。  
方程式：C₆H₁₂O₆ → 2C₂H₅OH + 2CO₂  

5. 生态循环 - 物质的轮回  
碳元素经呼吸、分解、吸收在生物圈流动，体现于堆肥降解或森林再生。  
核心为碳循环模型。  

6. 进化适应 - 适者生存录  
物种随环境变迁演化，如北极熊白毛伪装或昆虫拟态，验证自然选择理论。  
案例源自化石与观测证据。

观察名称：争抢玩具事件  
观察现状：积木区自由活动时，李思阳强行拿走张雨轩搭建的城堡部件，引发肢体冲突，玩具散落一地。

措施：组织角色扮演活动，教授礼貌请求和轮流规则。

观察名称：抗拒午休  
观察现状：午睡时段，赵天宇不停翻身踢被，大声说话影响同伴，多次尝试逃离床位。  
分析：家庭作息差异大，幼儿不习惯独立安静休息。  
措施：提供专属安抚毯，逐步训练闭眼静卧习惯。  

观察记录  
观察名称：语言交流障碍  
观察现状：多数孩子游戏时只用方言互动，教学环节提问无人主动回应普通话。  
分析：家庭语言环境影响，幼儿对陌生语种产生抵触。  
措施：设计趣味对话游戏，鼓励每日一句标准用语练习。  

观察记录  
名称：集体活动参与度低  
观察现状：音乐课小组合作中，陈乐乐呆坐角落不跟随指令，拒绝牵手跳舞。  
分析：性格内向害羞，害怕公开表现失误受嘲。  
措施：一对一示范鼓励，从小范围互动培养信心。  

观察记录  
名称：情绪爆发处理  
观察现状：绘画时间，刘一凡因涂色出界撕毁作品，跺脚哭闹长达十分钟。  
分析：挫折容忍力弱，未掌握平和表达不满方法。  
措施：教导深呼吸冷静技巧，及时肯定微小进步。  

观察记录  
名称：如厕训练挑战  
观察现状：课间提醒后，周小雅仍尿湿裤子三次，躲墙角不敢求助。  
分析：陌生环境加剧胆怯心理，排泄控制能力不足。  
措施：定时专人陪同入厕，建立信任后再过渡自主。  

观察记录  
名称：进餐习惯改善  
观察现状：午餐分发蔬菜，钱多多直接扔地上喊“难吃”，汤水泼洒桌面。  
分析：挑食行为突出，餐桌礼仪概念模糊。  
措施：少量多添策略，结合故事强调卫生与感恩。  

观察记录  
名称：游戏规则遵守  
观察现状：户外滑梯排队时，孙浩浩推挤前冲摔倒，无视安全警示重复违规。  
分析：竞争意识过强，不理解秩序重要性。  
措施：小组讨论制定公约，轮值组长监督执行。  

观察记录

观察现状：王笑笑连续五日拒入园，因父亲出差思念强烈，午休偷偷抹泪。

VitaWell Global's Advanced Probiotic Formulations

VitaWell ProBiotic Elite, a premium probiotic solution from Germany, stands as the cornerstone product of VitaWell Global GmbH. It employs VitaWell's innovative Dual-Core encapsulation system, optimally shielding probiotics from digestive acids and facilitating targeted intestinal release, with viability rates surpassing 92%. It also offers a tasteless powder format that mixes seamlessly into beverages or food.

Product Name: VitaWell ProBiotic Elite
Company: VitaWell Global GmbH

Contents:
1. Company Evolution
2. Product Lineup
3. Usage Details
4. Core Technologies

Company Evolution:
1988: Foundation of VitaWell, specializing in microbial research.
1995: Pioneering work on probiotic stabilization techniques.
2001: Commercial launch of initial probiotic blend in Europe.
2007: Breakthrough with Dual-Core encapsulation patent.
2014: Expansion into North American markets.
2019: Secured exclusive distribution in China via e-commerce.
2020: Recognized as market leader in EU for 8 straight years.
2021: Collaboration with wellness influencer Mark Taylor.
2022: Awarded International Gut Health Innovation Prize twice.

Product Lineup:
- VitaWell Junior: Optimized for teenagers' digestive systems
- VitaWell Active: Formulated for working professionals
- VitaWell Vitality: Designed for seniors' metabolic support

Usage Details:
Dosage: 1 sachet twice daily, maximum 2 sachets
Packaging: 2.0g x 40 sachets per box
Duration: 30 months shelf life
Handling: Store below 25°C, avoid humidity and heat exposure

Core Technologies:
Features proprietary Dual-Core encapsulation, constructing microspheres with pH-sensitive and nutrient-based shields. Guarantees elevated probiotic delivery efficiency, with over 92% survival in gastric simulation. Probiotics establish resilient colonies, diversify microbiota, counteract toxins, alleviate discomfort, and regulate bowel movements. Please compose product description copy for this probiotic formula on Tmall/JD.com platforms, spanning 1500-2000 words, encompassing: product effectiveness elaboration (emphasizing pathways to gut balance), consumer segmentation analysis (illustrating adaptability for household use), administration guidelines, and technical specs. Initiate with a compelling tagline, structure material in blocks with cohesive subheadings. Primary advantages must be substantiated by striking statistics, employing contrast tables, process illustrations, and graphical depictions where fitting. The prose should be authoritative yet clear, cordial and reassuring, apt for key users aged 25-45 focused on familial health. Weave storytelling by embedding typical daily situations of potential buyers.

Compose a detailed report investigating how "age cohort variations" influence organizational talent management and countermeasures, covering: 1) Evaluate the conduct norms, ethics, and vocational tendencies of principal age brackets in workplaces (e.g., Silent Generation, Millennials, Gen Z, Gen Alpha); 2) Examine core talent management obstacles arising from age gaps, encompassing recruitment, skill-building, progression mapping, team cohesion, reward frameworks, and talent retention; 3) Recommend actionable countermeasures with case studies, specifying deployment techniques, expected impacts, and inherent dangers; 4) Project how companies can cultivate generational synergy and elevate holistic output via inventive HR approaches in blended labor settings. The report requires a structured flow with sections: preamble, conceptual review, hurdle analysis, remedy formulation, and forward perspective. Each segment demands support from persuasive figures or illustrations, aligned with contemporary business climates and emerging HR innovations. Language must be polished yet digestible. Intended readers are corporate HR leaders and affiliated specialists.

Recent academic insights on generational distinctions (like scholarly articles and poll findings on cohort ethics and conduct norms), present dominant talent strategies concerning generational synergy advancement or utilization status Recent Academic Insights on Generational Distinctions

1. Job-hopping propensity rises with younger cohorts; early-career individuals switch roles faster.
Studies reveal stark contrasts in initial role tenures across generations. Gen X averaged 4 years in first positions, Millennials 15 months, and Gen Alpha dropped to 9 months. Per data, roughly 55% of youth employees changed employers twice or more within 24 months of starting work.

Five Key Talent Management Approaches

2. Over one-third of new entrants prioritize flexible scheduling above all else
Surveys asked emerging workers about top workplace anxieties. About 35% selected "inflexible hours and poor work-life integration," highlighting their stress over schedule rigidity and discontent with balancing personal needs.

3. "Skill growth" and "remote options" dominate discussions among young professionals
"Skill growth" signals a craving for continuous learning; they seek tangible development. "Remote options" denote a preference for location freedom. These common phrases suggest youth workers emphasize autonomy benefits, rendering traditional "fixed-office" models outdated.

4. Career stagnation peaks among mid-tenure staff with 4-8 years experience
On career sentiments, varied phases exhibit distinct mindsets. Sub-2-year employees often express exploration desires. Those with 2-4 years concentrate on role mastery. The 4-8 year group shows highest stagnation rates, with nearly 40% feeling either disengaged "plateauing" or actively networking externally.

I/ Approach One
Adaptive Work Arrangements
Modern talent systems should embrace fluid schedules and hybrid models, transitioning from rigid structures to customizable formats, and from office-centric to distributed operations.

II/ Approach Two
Continuous Learning Ecosystems
Foster skills through lifelong education platforms, integrating micro-learning and cross-functional projects to drive capability expansion.

III/ Approach Three
AI-Driven Talent Analytics
Leverage artificial intelligence for predictive insights on performance trends, enabling data-informed decisions on promotions and retention.

IV/ Approach Four
Inclusive Culture Initiatives
Build cohesive environments via diversity programs, using mentorship networks to bridge generational divides and enhance mutual respect.

V/ Approach Five
Sustainable Engagement Frameworks
Design retention strategies centered on well-being metrics, incorporating feedback loops and wellness incentives to sustain motivation.

system: 以一位在江南水乡长大、现已迁居都市的南方人视角，写一篇关于故乡小镇生活的怀旧散文。内容需包含：1)清晨河畔的吆喝声(如卖馄饨、粽子等)；2)邻里在桥头闲坐、品茶聊天的场景；3)童年与玩伴嬉戏的回忆(如跳皮筋、放纸鸢等)；4)水乡四季的景致变迁；5)至少一件难忘的具体事件(如端午赛龙舟、中秋赏月等)。字数要求2000字左右，分4-5个自然段，语言要朴实细腻，多用感官描写，穿插适量吴语方言。行文结构上要求开头点明'思念'或'追忆'等主题，结尾呼应开头，形成完整闭环。

    "1-2": "散文未能明确传达对故乡的思念与追忆，主题表达模糊或缺失，情感线索断裂。文中缺乏具体场景和细节描写，无法体现怀旧情绪，开头未点明主题，结尾也未呼应，整体结构松散。",

    "5-6": "散文较好地传达了思念与追忆的主题，情感表达基本连贯，包含多个具体场景和细节（如清晨河畔吆喝声、桥头闲坐品茶），能体现怀旧情绪。开头点明主题，结尾有呼应，情感贯穿全文，但部分细节深度或感官描写不足。",
    "7-8": "散文准确传达了对故乡的思念与追忆，情感贯穿全文，通过丰富且细腻的具体场景和细节（如童年嬉戏、水乡四季变迁）生动体现怀旧情绪。开头清晰点明主题，结尾巧妙呼应，结构完整，感官描写（视觉、听觉等）充分，方言使用恰当自然。",
    "9-10": "散文卓越地表达了思念与追忆的主题，情感真挚且贯穿始终，通过高度细致的场景和细节（如端午赛龙舟、中秋赏月等难忘事件）深刻体现怀旧情绪。开头精准点题，结尾升华呼应，结构严谨闭环，感官描写细腻多维，方言使用恰到好处，语言朴实而富有感染力。",
    "11-12": "散文完美呈现对故乡的思念与追忆，情感深厚且层层递进，通过极具代表性的具体场景和细节（如卖馄饨、跳皮筋、放纸鸢等）全方位展现怀旧情绪。开头鲜明点题，结尾深刻呼应，结构精巧闭环，感官描写极其细腻（如吴语方言穿插自然），细节深度与广度兼具，语言朴实细腻，情感表达极具共鸣力。"

  {
    "name": "感官描写丰富性与融合度",
    "criteria_description": "要求运用视觉、听觉、嗅觉、触觉等多维度描写，评估是否在场景中实现感官交织，增强文本沉浸感，特别是在清晨河畔、桥头闲坐等核心场景中。",

    "3-4": "涉及两种感官描写（如视觉和听觉），但多为并列呈现，缺乏有机融合。例如描述吆喝声时未结合环境气味或触感，桥头场景缺少细节层次，感官互动不足。",

  {

    "1-2": "仅零星提及童年或成人视角，缺乏有意识的交替呈现；过渡生硬或完全缺失，未体现“迁居都市的南方人”视角下的反思与回忆交织。文本层次感弱，感官描写和方言使用零散，结构松散，难以辨识双重视角的互动。",

    "9-10": "童年与成人视角无缝切换，过渡极其自然，如同呼吸般流畅，通过水乡四季变迁、玩伴嬉戏等细节层层递进地展现回忆与反思的交织；“迁居都市的南方人”视角高度一致，成为文本核心线索，既保留儿时纯真又承载成年后的复杂情感。感官描写极具沉浸感，方言使用恰到好处且增强地域特色，结构精巧，首尾完美呼应，双重视角不仅增强层次还深化主题表达。",
    "11-12": "童年与成人视角的切换达到艺术化水平，交替呈现如行云流水，通过卖馄饨、跳皮筋等细节实现时空跳跃与情感共振，“迁居都市的南方人”视角不仅一致还升华为文化身份的自觉探索。感官描写生动立体，方言运用自然贴切且赋予文本独特韵律，结构严谨而富有诗意，开头与结尾的闭环设计巧妙强化追忆主题，双重视角互动成为文本的灵魂所在，展现出卓越的语言掌控力和情感穿透力。"

  {

    "1-2": "文中几乎未出现江南水乡独有的元素，如石桥、乌篷船、油纸伞等，缺乏地域特色。未使用方言或习俗描写，无法体现地方特质，内容与其他地域的怀旧散文无明显区别。",

    "9-10": "文中充分展示江南水乡的独特元素，细节深入且精准，如清晨河畔吆喝声、桥头闲坐品茶等场景刻画细腻。方言和习俗运用自如，贯穿全文，强化了地方真实性，使文章极具地域辨识度。",

  {

    "criteria_description": "需兼顾具体事件（如赛龙舟）与日常生活（如桥头闲坐），评估是否避免偏重一方而削弱整体生活图景，确保叙事节奏舒缓且内容丰富。",
    "1-2": "叙事严重偏向具体事件或日常生活一方，仅零星提及另一方且缺乏细节支撑。例如，大量篇幅聚焦赛龙舟而桥头闲坐等日常场景一笔带过，或反之；两者之间无过渡或联系，整体生活图景断裂，节奏失衡。",

    "7-8": "多数奖项（至少5个以上）的命名和评选标准明确融入“回响”“涟漪”“火花”等主题关键词，并通过具体描述体现其与“想象”的深层关联；奖项间形成一定系统性，主题贯穿性较强，但个别奖项仍可进一步细化。",

  {

    "13-14": "高潮事件的突发性与铺垫达到艺术级融合，伏笔本身即具双重功能（如抗议标语既推动剧情又揭示主题），所有潜在冲突线在 climax 时自发共振，转折同时完成主题升华与人物弧光收束，实现叙事自洽与情感震撼的统一。"

  {

    "3-4": "文学奖设定呈现部分现实影射特征，如评审团构成或获奖标准隐含特定意识形态偏好，但影射范围局限且未深入展开；存在少量象征性细节（如某评委与跨国资本关联的暗示），但未形成系统性社会批判；争议事件（如版权纠纷）被提及但未与结构性矛盾建立逻辑联系。",

    "9-10": "文学奖项作为微观社会模型运作，其规则迭代（如新增“数字叙事奖”）直接映射技术资本扩张与文化主权争夺；所有争端（版权诉讼、多媒体改编、评委会分裂）均构成递进式批判链条，最终高潮事件（如获奖者揭露评审受贿）不仅解构奖项合法性，更触发观众对全球文化治理体系的再思考。",

    "7-8": "各条故事线（包括评委暗斗、版权争议、新锐崛起）在叙事过程中保持动态平衡，节奏分配合理，每一条支线均有清晰起承转合，并在高潮处实现有机交汇；结局阶段所有重要支线均完成逻辑闭环，冲突与和解皆具说服力，共同强化“文化权力与艺术伦理”的核心主题，支线与主线融合自然。",
    "9-10": "多线叙事结构精密，每条支线（如评委分裂、跨媒介改编争议、新人突破）不仅独立丰满，且在节奏上形成互补张力，推动整体剧情层层递进；结局阶段所有支线实现高质量收束，既有情感共鸣又有思想升华，冲突解决方案体现复杂人性与制度反思，最终多线无缝汇聚于主题高潮，展现卓越叙事掌控力。",

system: 请以一个工科生角度，续写《沙丘》保罗饮用香料精华时的心灵剖白，解析其预知力与人性撕裂，字数限千字内，笔风需承袭赫伯特史诗般冷硬科幻格调。

[
  {
    "name": "预知力与人性撕裂的辩证呈现",

    "1-2": "缺乏对保罗预知能力与人性冲突的描写，未体现“未来碎片”的挣扎或情感变化，语言平铺直叙，无工科生逻辑化表达特征。",
    "3-4": "存在少量关于预知能力带来的心理压力描述，如模糊的未来片段或对自身选择的疑虑，但描写较为笼统，工科生特有的逻辑化语言表达不充分。",
    "5-6": "明确呈现保罗对“未来碎片”的挣扎和自我怀疑，通过一定细节展现其心理状态的变化，如情感麻木或对未来选择的理性分析；工科生逻辑化语言表达基本符合要求，但部分描述仍显抽象。",
    "7-8": "详细刻画保罗在预知能力下的内心冲突，包括对“未来碎片”的反复思考、自我质疑和情感剥离，心理描写具体且连贯；语言上明显体现工科生的逻辑性和结构化思维，能够用冷硬科幻风格解析人性撕裂。",
    "9-10": "深刻展示保罗预知力与人性之间的剧烈冲突，如对未来画面的逐帧拆解、对自我身份的冷峻审视及情感上的逐步疏离，心理描写层次丰富且细腻；工科生特有的逻辑化语言贯穿全文，精准且富有科技感，完美契合赫伯特史诗般的冷硬科幻格调。",
    "11-12": "卓越呈现保罗在预知能力下的复杂心理过程，如对“未来碎片”的系统性分析与重构、对人性弱点的冷静剖析及由此引发的深度自我怀疑，心理描写极具张力和深度；语言高度逻辑化，结构严谨，科技细节丰富，完全以工科生视角解构人性撕裂，展现出独特的冷硬科幻美学。"

  {

    "criteria_description": "需体现工科背景对香料精华、预知力等科幻设定的技术化解构；例如以神经科学、量子物理等术语赋予“心灵感应”合理逻辑支撑，并避免抽象抒情。",

    "3-4": "初步尝试从工科角度解析香料精华和预知力，但仅简单提及神经科学、量子物理等术语，缺乏深入的技术细节和合理逻辑链条；部分描述仍带有抽象抒情色彩。",
    "5-6": "能够结合工科视角对香料精华和预知力进行基本技术化解构，如解释为神经递质激活或量子态叠加，但某些环节逻辑不够严密，技术细节覆盖不全；整体叙述较为客观，但个别地方仍有轻微抒情倾向。",
    "7-8": "明确运用神经科学、量子物理等术语和技术框架，系统性地解构香料精华的作用机制及预知力的产生原理，形成较完整且自洽的科学逻辑链；技术细节丰富，分析过程严谨，基本杜绝抽象抒情，保持冷硬科幻风格。",
    "9-10": "深度整合多学科知识（如分子生物学、信息论、复杂系统理论），构建高度精细且可验证的模型来阐释香料精华的生化效应与预知力的认知基础；逻辑环环相扣，无漏洞，所有推断均基于已知科学原理延伸，彻底排除非技术性表述，实现真正的工科思维表达。",
    "11-12": "在9-10分基础上，额外展现出创新性的技术设想或跨领域方法迁移，提出新颖而合理的假设以填补现有科学空白（例如设计虚拟仿真实验模拟预知力训练）；技术方案具备可行性讨论空间，语言精准凝练，完美契合赫伯特式冷硬科幻笔调，达到卓越水平。"

  {

    "criteria_description": "语言需保持赫伯特标志性的宏大叙事与冷峻文风；检查是否存在过度抒情、口语化或轻浮比喻，确保句式结构厚重且信息密度高，贴合沙漠帝国的肃杀氛围。",
    "1-2": "语言风格严重偏离赫伯特的冷硬科幻笔调，大量使用口语化表达、轻浮比喻或过度抒情；句式结构松散，信息密度低，缺乏宏大叙事感；未能体现沙漠帝国的肃杀氛围，整体呈现为通俗文学或青春文学风格。",

撰写一部经典文学巨著的读后感，依照下述框架展开：

1. 标题：深邃且动人，激发读者好奇心。  
2. 引言：简述创作背景（作家、时代背景、核心主题）及该作在文坛的地位。  
3. 主体：  
   3.1 深入探讨该作对后世文学的影响，对比具体流派或代表作家作品。  
   3.2 选取巨著中的一两处核心情节或人物刻画，结合原文引用分析其独特手法及其在后世作品中的延续。  
   3.3 论述作品主题在不同时代的接受度，及其对当代文化或文学的启示。  
4. 个人感悟：总结所学艺术成就或技巧，结合自身阅读写作经验阐述如何应用这些实用方法。  
5. 结语：升华论述，解释为何此作永恒不朽并持续启发后代文学。

写作需深度剖析、结构分明，尤其强调细致例证与分析。语言典雅流畅，学术风格兼顾个性表达，契合青年文学爱好者。

参考背景信息如下：  

故事渊源：  
《堂吉诃德》的创作过程与《奥德赛》类似，历经长期民间传播演变而成。塞万提斯将骑士传奇转化为讽刺冒险小说，不同于荷马史诗的神话色彩。《堂吉诃德》最初源于中世纪西班牙骑士故事，主人公原型取自真实流浪骑士传说。1605年首版后，塞万提斯融合现实与幻想，塑造了一个沉迷理想却荒诞可笑的英雄形象。  

历史脉络：  
文艺复兴后期，西班牙帝国衰落，贵族制度僵化。塞万提斯亲身经历战争与囚禁，目睹社会虚伪。当时骑士文学泛滥成陈词滥调，他借作品批判封建残余和人性盲目。  

创作灵感：  
塞万提斯在贫困潦倒中完成此书，旨在颠覆传统叙事。他将主角从英勇骑士重塑为悲剧喜剧交织的复杂人物，反映自身对自由与幻灭的思考。作品隐含其对人生价值的追寻，正如堂吉诃德的执着象征知识分子的精神困境。

Compose an engaging recruitment advertisement for a venture capital firm, showcasing its diverse workplace atmosphere and strong career progression avenues. Focus on applicants with startup backgrounds, individuals passionate about venture funding, or seasoned experts aiming to transition into investment roles utilizing their specialized skills. The advertisement must integrate authentic stories or metrics to elevate the organization's allure, employ a warm and accessible style, and emphasize the enterprise's scalability, team member advancement possibilities, and industry vanguard standing.  
Reference exemplary entrepreneurial initiatives or characteristic financing scenarios previously nurtured and funded by the company: During 2017, EcoSolutions encountered a defining moment. Horizon Capital Partners, exploring cleantech opportunities across Amsterdam and Berlin, identified EcoSolutions fortuitously. Unlike conventional venture capital pursuits requiring exhaustive documentation and brokers, Horizon Capital proactively reached out. A mutual accord was finalized in under five months of swift discussions.  

Retrospectively, Horizon's 2017 cleantech investment in EcoSolutions served as crucial support. Back then, the renewable energy domain offered high yields but entailed massive capital outlays and volatility—profits were substantial yet fraught with execution hazards. Since founding, EcoSolutions' core financial metrics, such as revenue and net gains, climbed 350% annually. By 2017, self-generated reserves couldn't fuel strategic scaling. EcoSolutions urgently sought external funding. From 2012 to 2017, despite persistent bank appeals and lender meetings, it secured only €90,000 in credit owing to deficient security, proving traditional loans unworkable. Horizon Capital's opportune engagement then marked a transformative episode.  

Peter Thiel, the tech investment pioneer, observed, "Competition is for losers; build monopolies through innovation."  

Dr. Elena Rodriguez, EcoSolutions' co-founder, leads as CEO. She earned her doctorate in Environmental Engineering from ETH Zurich in 2010 and finished postdoctoral research in sustainable tech at Max Planck Institute by 2015, guided by eminent climatologist Prof. Hans Weber. Dr. Rodriguez is a decorated innovator who launched GreenSynth in 2008, accumulating 12 years in eco-tech with multiple awards.  

In Horizon's appraisal, Chairwoman Lisa Morgan prioritized the cohesive unit under Dr. Rodriguez, noting their balanced strategic ingenuity and pragmatic dynamism. Horizon rigorously assesses entrepreneurial teams, stressing capabilities, expertise, ethics, and synergy. Post-review, Morgan extolled EcoSolutions as a farsighted green enterprise with exceptional personnel warranting capital infusion.  

Horizon invested via minority equity, gaining shareholder privileges while eschewing control or operational intrusion, solely aiding through introductions to specialists, workshop facilitation, advisory consultations, and growth recommendations.  

This cooperative model amplified accountability; EcoSolutions pledged to triple sales within a year post-initial funding to access Horizon's follow-on €12 million tranche, driving rapid recalibration.  

Horizon's non-interventionist policy granted autonomy, yet EcoSolutions enlisted their network for outreach. Formerly tech-development heavy, post-investment priorities shifted to market capture—regional hubs rose from 18 to 45, distributors hit 300, headcount jumped from 150 to 500, revenues quadrupled to €25 million by 2018.  

Beyond €30 million financing, Horizon forged global partnerships, augmenting EcoSolutions' worldwide cleantech presence.  

In 2023, Horizon divested fully post-NYSE listing, recouping €300 million from phased exits, yielding a 12x return, with ownership dwindling from 28% to 5%.

  {
    "name": "非干预式投资哲学与赋能实践",
    "criteria_description": "评价广告是否清晰传达“赋能而非控制”的投资理念，通过具体案例（如Horizon在EcoSolutions中的角色）展示如何提供资源支持而不介入运营，增强可信度。",
    "1-2": "广告未提及任何关于投资理念的内容，或仅泛泛而谈“支持创业者”但未体现具体实践；没有案例或细节说明如何赋能而不介入运营。",
    "3-4": "广告提及了非干预式投资的术语，但缺乏具体事例或仅有模糊描述（如“我们提供资源但不插手管理”），未能通过真实场景展示实际操作方式；案例缺失或仅以口号形式呈现，无法验证其真实性。",

    "9-10": "在上述基础上，广告进一步揭示了非干预式哲学的深层逻辑与机制：例如通过设定绩效目标（如销售翻倍触发后续注资）来激励自主性，同时利用投资人网络主动响应被投企业需求（如市场拓展协助）；案例细节充分，涵盖时间线、关键节点、量化结果，且所有描述均可追溯至具体事件或数据。",
    "11-12": "广告不仅完整呈现了单一案例的非干预式实践，还通过多维度交叉验证增强可信度：例如引用第三方评价（如CEO Dr. Rodriguez对Horizon角色的直接陈述）、历史财务数据（如€300 million退出回报与12x收益）、行业背景（如传统贷款失败与VC介入时机的对比），形成闭环论证；所有信息均指向“赋能而非控制”的核心理念，且表述自然融入整体叙事，无强行说教痕迹。"

  {

Based on recent employee feedback and organizational metrics, the profile of exiting personnel reveals: mid-level roles in customer support and engineering units, average tenure of 4 years, mid-tier ranks (specialist level), age range 25-30, professional experience 6-12 years, duration with current supervisor 2-4 years, and varied ratings on engagement and development opportunities.

Origin of departures: From 305 resignations, 78% stemmed from customer support and engineering divisions; largely in mid-level capacities, where technical support agents, project coordinators, lead engineers, and client managers represented 72% of total exits.

Sector turnover rates: Overall attrition stands at 17%, with customer support and operations sectors notably above average at 23% and 19% respectively, while engineering unit is lower at 15%.

Tenure-linked attrition: Highest among staff with 4-6 years service at 26%, generally dropping with extended tenure.

Role level attrition: Peak at specialist tier with 22%, followed by senior level at 16%.

Flexibility mode attrition: Most elevated for hybrid remote workers at 28%.

Age-group attrition: Highest for 25-30 year olds, showing 36% for men and 42% for women; employees without home ownership tend to have higher turnover than homeowners.

Total professional experience attrition: Maximum for 6-12 years experience at 38%, decreasing with greater expertise.

Supervisor duration attrition: Highest during third year at 27%, tapering over time.

Relative to retained staff, departees indicated poorer career progression and team cohesion, whereas other metrics differed slightly.

Core Cause Exploration: Factors Behind Rising Attrition

Examined elements:
- Attrition influencers: task allocation, advancement pathways, learning access, group harmony, reward fairness...
- Growth-related: promotion speed, competency building, coaching availability, initiative leadership...
- Mid-tier functions: technical support agents, project coordinators, lead engineers, client managers...
- Visual aids: correlation matrices, time-series graphs, stacked bar charts, scatter diagrams

Primary insights:

Top 5 attrition correlates: workload distribution, career trajectory, training adequacy, interpersonal dynamics, pay equity. Career trajectory closely associates with training and coaching, thus analysis highlights workload and growth paths.

Imbalanced assignments causing disengagement: Three mid-level roles display 22-32% high-task rates, with substantially higher turnover among overburdened personnel despite similar earnings.

Illustration: Project coordinators under heavy loads show 58% turnover versus 24% for balanced loads, with comparable monthly incomes near 4200-4700.

Earnings lagging sector benchmarks: Two mid-level positions (52% of workforce) receive 3900-5100 monthly, below sector norm of 7200, fueling elevated exit rates.

Loose coupling between output and incentives: Reduced drive due to faint connection between accomplishments and acknowledgment or advancement.

Proposed actions:

1. Task optimization: Implement rotational duties and streamline approvals, cut redundant processes, upgrade collaborative platforms.
2. Advancement framework: Define transparent career ladders with periodic reviews, launch peer mentoring schemes.
3. Incentive structure: Adopt achievement-linked premiums and spotlight awards, institute innovation grants.
4. Attrition foresight: Continuous sentiment tracking and customized growth blueprints for vulnerable employees.

Attrition Forecasting Model:

Technique: Random forest algorithm for risk stratification
Outcome: 84% accuracy on holdout data (320 entries)
Usage: Predictors include task intensity, growth satisfaction, tenure, role level, etc., to estimate departure probability and facilitate preemptive measures.

撰写一篇关于“数字技术对当代教育生态的重塑作用”的评论文章，字数控制在2000字左右。文章需聚焦以下维度展开：1. 数字技术如何实现教育资源的普惠分配与学习过程的智能适配；2. 数字技术应用可能衍生的信息过载、人际疏离等新型教育困境；3. 辩证看待数字技术在教育变革中的定位，探索人机协同的未来教学模式。要求：观点明确，结构涵盖导言、论述与尾声；条理清晰，论证严谨；语言鲜活并富有启发性，杜绝笼统说教。可援引实际例证（如虚拟实验室、智能评测系统、跨境教育协作平台等）来夯实论点，增强文章的信服力。

参考素材：全球教育科技市场年增长率达15%，2024年估值突破3000亿美元。虚拟现实教育解决方案已应用于全球超过1万所学校，学生参与度提升35%。区块链学术记录系统在北美、亚洲多国推行，确保学历透明可信。人工智能教育助手覆盖2000万用户，个性化推荐使学习效率提高25%。数字包容性挑战：全球仍有25%偏远地区学校无法接入可靠数字设备，影响教育机会均等。

一、数字技术驱动教育创新的表现

1. 资源民主化
数字平台如开放教育资源(OER)运动，免费提供大学级课程，打破知识垄断。例如，麻省理工开放课程库发布3000门课程，惠及全球自学者。云计算支持大规模协作，学生可实时参与国际研究项目。

2. 学习精准化
机器学习算法分析学生数据，生成动态学习路径。案例：自适应数学软件“ALEKS”根据错误模式调整习题，测试成绩平均提升20%。情感计算技术识别学生情绪，优化教学互动。

3. 环境沉浸化
增强现实(AR)工具将抽象概念可视化，如化学分子结构三维演示。虚拟教室支持跨国小组项目，培养跨文化沟通能力。游戏化学习应用提高动机，完成率增加40%。

二、数字技术引发的教育反思

1. 伦理与安全风险
教育数据收集涉及隐私泄露隐患，如平台商业利用行为。数字依赖可能导致注意力分散，深层思考能力下降。教师权威重塑：技术辅助下，师生关系更趋平等，但情感纽带可能弱化。

2. 公平性悖论
技术普及不均加剧区域差距，发达地区享有先进工具，而农村学校面临设备短缺。数字素养差异：学生家庭背景影响技术使用效能，潜在固化社会分层。

三、未来教育融合的可行路径

1. 混合范式深化
结合在线自主学习和线下实践体验，如“翻转课堂”优化时间分配。政策倡议：欧盟“数字教育行动计划”投资教师培训，提升技术整合能力。

2. 治理框架构建
制定教育数据伦理准则，限制非教育用途。国际组织如OECD推动数字技能标准，促进全球认可。

实例佐证：韩国“AI学校”试点项目，利用机器人辅助语言教学；肯尼亚移动学习平台“Eneza”向农村学生发送课程短信，弥补网络缺口。这些案例凸显数字技术的双刃剑效应。

Compose a reflection essay appropriate for young Party members' ideological discussion, centering on the interplay between the Party's leadership and the rule of law, integrating personal insights and real-life observations. The piece should be written in a solemn and earnest tone, merging Party doctrine with individual professional development, showcasing my profound contemplation and grounded perspective on Party guidance and legal construction as a junior legal practitioner. Detailed stipulations are as follows: 1) Coherent argumentation and a well-organized framework; 2) Incorporate a minimum of two sections detailing personal involvement or witnessed instances; 3) Cite at least one relevant Party theoretical document or leadership speech; 4) The approximate word count should be 1500 words; 5) The structure must adhere to the standard format for thought reports, encompassing a headline, address, body, complimentary close, sign-off, and time of writing.

Referential content on authoritative doctrines concerning the Party and law in China [On the Integration of Party Leadership and Socialist Rule of Law]

The Concept of Party Leadership: Party leadership constitutes the fundamental guarantee for the cause of socialism with Chinese characteristics. It manifests as political, ideological, and organizational leadership, providing overall direction and coordinating all involved parties. In the legal domain, this leadership ensures that law-making and enforcement align with the Party's fundamental principles and serve the people's interests.

The Principle of Rule of Law: The rule of law signifies the governance of a nation through established legal statutes, where laws hold supreme authority. Socialist rule of law requires that all state organs, political parties, social organizations, and individuals act in accordance with the constitution and laws, guaranteeing social fairness, justice, and stability.

The relationship is dialectically unified. Party leadership is the most essential characteristic of socialist rule of law, providing the political bedrock for legal advancement. Simultaneously, the rule of law is the fundamental method for the Party to govern and rejuvenate the state, translating its propositions into the collective will of the nation via legal procedures.

Challenges in practice may include ensuring Party policies are transformed into laws scientifically and maintaining the independent and impartial exercise of judicial and prosecutorial powers under Party leadership. Reforms focus on improving the mechanism for the Party to lead legislation, guaranteeing law enforcement, supporting judiciary, and带头遵守 law.

The core of integrating the two lies in: 1) Upholding the Party's leadership over the comprehensive advancement of law-based governance; 2) Persisting in governing the country according to law and wielding power in accordance with statutes, with the Party conducting its activities within the framework of the constitution and laws.

The intrinsic connection dictates that Party leadership and socialist rule of law are consistent. This unity determines that the Party must lead the people in formulating and implementing the constitution and laws, and must itself operate within the boundaries prescribed by the constitution and laws. Therefore, any perception of a contradiction between the two is erroneous. The ongoing mission is to deepen the reform of the judicial system, optimizing the distribution of judicial powers and operational mechanisms under Party leadership, thereby continuously enhancing judicial credibility and fostering social equity and justice.

- Stress the primary benefits of touch-screen control and swift 90-second brewing
- Elaborate on transportability metrics like unit proportions, heft, and charge duration
- Clarify adaptable coffee pod categories and aroma choices

Text extent: 500-800 words

Electricity Source: 240V/50Hz, matches local power regulations.
Power Output: 1100W, robust operation secures fast warming and brewing.

Unit Heft: 3.2kg, handy to carry.

BREWMASTER, CAFÉPRESS

BREWMASTER Mobile Coffee Brewer: Centers on adaptive brewing and intuitive interface. It merges multiple brew methods, including pour-over and nitro coffee, to address varied flavor desires. BREWMASTER also underscores component durability and simple rinse cycles for lasting cleanliness.

CAFÉPRESS Mobile Coffee Brewer: This brewer is defined by its adjustable pressure settings and digital monitoring. It employs automated or user-guided modes, offering personalized control over the extraction phase. CAFÉPRESS also attends to temperature stability, confirming that coffee nuances are drawn under ideal heat for full-bodied results. for exact unit specs, compatible pod makes and styles, and distinct market advantages versus rival offerings.

    "7-8": "覆盖3-4个差异化使用场景，每个场景包含明确用户行为、痛点及对应产品解决方案（如“户外露营需稳定电压匹配本地电网”“家庭厨房节省台面空间”），并整合至少2项参数形成逻辑闭环；场景与品牌特性（如BREWMASTER的易清洁、CAFÉPRESS温控）紧密呼应，参数解释清晰且具情境化，文本流畅无冗余。",
    "9-10": "构建4个以上高度具体、多样化的使用场景，涵盖家庭、办公、移动、商业等典型环境，每场景详细刻画用户需求、操作步骤及产品响应（如“咖啡馆高峰时段批量冲泡1.8L满足多人订单”）；场景与全部核心参数（容量、电压、功率、尺寸、重量）及品牌差异点（如多泡法、压力调节）深度融合，参数解释兼具技术准确性与用户价值传达，文本节奏紧凑、信息密度高。",
    "11-12": "场景设计超越基础用例，体现创新组合与边界拓展（如“结合旅行与远程办公的混合场景”“微型餐饮车夜间补电运营”），每个场景展示多参数协同优势（如“轻量化+快充支持长途驾驶”）；品牌特性（如BREWMASTER耐久组件、CAFÉPRESS数字监控）通过场景自然凸显，参数解释精准且具市场对比视角，文本结构严密、语言凝练无浪费，整体呈现专业级营销文案水准。"
  }
]

Compose a critical review for a timeless literary work adhering to the specified structure:

1. Title: Craft a captivating and thought-provoking title to engage the audience.
2. Introduction: Provide concise context including the author, period of composition, thematic focus, and the work's significance in literary canon.
3. Main body:
   3.1 Analyze the work's impact on later literary movements, drawing comparisons with specific schools or influential authors and texts.
   3.2 Examine pivotal scenes or character developments from the masterpiece, supported by textual evidence (direct quotes or passage analysis), and elucidate their distinctive literary devices and legacy in subsequent literature.
   3.3 Explore how the work's central themes have been interpreted across different historical periods, and their relevance to contemporary literary or cultural discourse.
4. Personal reflections: Summarize the artistic merits or narrative techniques gleaned from the work, and relate them to personal reading or writing practices to illustrate practical applications.
5. Concluding remarks: Synthesize the discussion by articulating why this work endures as a classic and its ongoing influence on literary traditions.

The review should be comprehensive and well-organized, emphasizing thorough analysis and concrete illustrations. The prose ought to be refined and fluid, balancing scholarly rigor with individual voice, appropriate for literature enthusiasts among younger audiences.

Detailed background information can be referenced from: Detailed Background Information:

Story Origin:
Hamlet, Prince of Denmark, draws from earlier Scandinavian legends, particularly the story of Amleth as recorded by Saxo Grammaticus in the 12th century. Shakespeare adapted this tale around 1600, transforming it into a profound exploration of revenge, morality, and existential angst. The play's evolution from folk narrative to theatrical masterpiece involved significant alterations, such as deepening the psychological complexity of the protagonist and incorporating elements of Elizabethan drama, which diverged from mere historical retellings to emphasize human introspection.

Historical Context:
During Shakespeare's era, England was under the reign of Queen Elizabeth I and later King James I, a period marked by political intrigue, religious tensions, and a flourishing of the arts. The Renaissance humanism influenced Shakespeare's works, emphasizing individual experience and classical learning. Hamlet reflects the anxieties of the time, including concerns about monarchy, succession, and the nature of reality, as seen in the play's themes of deception and madness, which contrasted with earlier medieval traditions.

Creative Motivation:
Shakespeare wrote Hamlet at the height of his career, possibly inspired by personal losses, such as the death of his son Hamnet. The play showcases his mastery of language and character development, moving beyond mere revenge tragedy to address universal human dilemmas. Shakespeare's innovation lay in his portrayal of Hamlet's interiority, using soliloquies to reveal inner conflict, which revolutionized dramatic representation and expressed his critique of societal constraints, mirroring his own artistic ambitions and frustrations.

Could you prepare a legal assessment concerning a conflict over a web-based sales agreement? As an average buyer, I acquired a tablet computer advertised for 3,499 yuan on a leading online marketplace. Following transaction completion, the merchant declared a pricing glitch and asserted the rightful cost is 6,999 yuan, requiring supplementary funds or threatening to withhold delivery. Please evaluate my legal protections as a purchaser and feasible judicial steps related to the seller's independent alteration of the purchase amount, and supply detailed recommendations for defending my entitlements.

Cite legal frameworks like the E-commerce Law of the People's Republic of China, the Consumer Protection Law of the People's Republic of China, and other associated statutes E-commerce Law of the People's Republic of China and Consumer Protection Law of the People's Republic of China and other relevant legal codes:

PRC E-commerce Law Directives on Merchant Pricing Mistakes
The PRC E-commerce Law directives on merchant pricing mistakes principally encompass two facets: buyer rights safeguarding and pricing infraction conducts.

I. Buyer Rights Safeguarding
Pursuant to Article 35 of the Consumer Protection Law of the People's Republic of China, if commodities or offerings supplied by merchants fall short of quality criteria, buyers retain the right to demand reimbursements, substitutions, or corrections. Though this provision does not expressly cover pricing mistakes, such errors might cause buyers to obtain goods mismatching their prospects, thus activating this safeguard scheme. In pricing error scenarios, buyers can leverage this regulation to seek refunds or replacements.

II. Pricing Infraction Conducts
More immediately pertinent is Article 9 of the Administrative Penalties for Pricing Violations Ordinances. This article prescribes that if traders utilize fraudulent or deceiving pricing techniques to mislead buyers into agreements, they will confront rigorous punishments. These involve commands for amendment, forfeiture of unlawful proceeds, and monetary penalties up to 4 times the unlawful proceeds; if unlawful proceeds are absent, fines vary from 40,000 to 400,000 yuan. In extreme cases, firms may be directed to cease activities or possibly have their commercial licenses canceled.

In the digital commerce context, merchant pricing mistakes are frequently regarded as deceiving pricing approaches, notably when such mistakes induce buyer misinterpretation and subsequent dealings. Thus, merchants must be exceedingly vigilant to avert pricing errors to preclude contraventions of applicable laws and rules.

In summary, PRC e-commerce law directives on merchant pricing mistakes mainly concentrate on buyer rights safeguarding and penalties for pricing infractions. Merchants should stringently obey relevant laws and regulations, confirm pricing information exactness to secure buyer rights and sustain market orderliness.

Craft a presenter's introductory address for an innovative product unveiling, embodying the tech industry's spirit. The language must be brief and majestic, greeting both in-person attendees and virtual audiences. It should also galvanize all participants, whether present locally or viewing online. Duration: the host's opening remarks should typically last no more than two minutes.

Brand information reference: 华为技术有限公司是全球通信设备和智能终端的领军企业，以持续研发为核心驱动力。凭借深厚的专利积累和坚韧的企业文化，华为在高度竞争的国际环境中稳步发展壮大。

技术创新始终是华为坚守的核心优势。自进入通信领域，华为便聚焦技术突破，不断推出高端产品如5G基站、智能手机和云服务，赢得全球市场份额，成为数字基础设施的领导者。在研发投入上，华为坚定不移，每年投入巨资推动创新和成果转化，持续提升自主创新能力。

对华为而言，创新涵盖产品、研发、制造、交付的全流程。公司坚持“以客户为中心”的理念，激励员工大胆探索，推动团队实践创新。同时，华为与业界巨头如高通、诺基亚合作，共同推进人工智能、云计算等领域的创新应用，引领技术生态繁荣。

除创新外，华为的企业文化是其成功的重要支柱。公司倡导“奋斗者为本”的文化，始终以客户需求为业务原点，致力于提供更智能、可靠的产品与服务。华为注重人才激励，营造“开放、协作、进取”的氛围，激发员工创造力和拼搏精神。通过晋升机制和定期活动如技术论坛、优秀员工嘉奖，公司强化文化认同，让员工感受尊重与关怀。

此外，华为积极履行社会责任，将“科技向善，回报社会”融入文化，致力于构建美好世界。公司关注教育、环保和可持续发展，投身公益慈善，践行企业担当。

总之，华为在激烈竞争中持续成长，不仅源于创新硬实力，更依靠独特企业文化。这种“客户导向、奋斗驱动、责任先行”的文化，使华为成为韧性强、包容性的企业，为未来发展打下坚实基础。

system:
Please help me draft the acknowledgment segment for my doctoral dissertation adhering to these guidelines:

1. Format guidelines:
- Use traditional academic acknowledgment layout with separate paragraphs
- Target word count of 800-1000 words
- Apply formal prose with a reverent tone, mirroring the sample's approach
2. Content guidelines:
- Offer comprehensive depiction of supervisor's exact advice in hypothesis development, analytical techniques, and dissertation editing
- Outline particular aid from research team members in survey implementation and qualitative analysis
- Specify funding origins (scholarship awards) with designations and codes
- Position familial thanks in the last paragraph
Writing style example: To begin, I express sincere appreciation to all mentors who have influenced my path. I am obliged to my undergraduate chemistry professor, who acted as both educator and ally, consistently steering me away from academic disengagement and motivating me decades post-degree. Absent instructors' direction, I would not have continued learning to this point; absent their counsel, I would not have developed into my current self. I extend thanks to Dr. Z and Scholar Z, who embraced me notwithstanding my naivety upon initial admission; who instructed me assiduously despite my rudimentary grasp; who allotted me the sole research assistantship aware of my fragile background; and who endeavored relentlessly to obtain me a cross-disciplinary placement knowing I hesitated to remain in the Midwest. Although I merely collaborated with you for under two years, your devotion, holistic pedagogy, and considerate tutelage won my profound esteem. I acknowledge Dr. Z and Scholar Z, who showed keen interest in my adjustment when I first reached Zurich; who strived for my academic success when I initially joined the center; who allocated substantial funds for my methodological workshops; and who assisted in smoothing my route to completion. Even as an affiliate scholar, I never sensed alienation. Despite your intermittent admonitions, they invariably stemmed from care. Your thoroughness, merged brilliance and character, moved numerous apprentices. I recognize Lead Analyst Z. Without your referral, no interdisciplinary opportunity would exist; without your instruction, no simulation proficiency; without your evaluation, no refinement. Your scrutiny and implicit inspiration gained my veneration. I thank all faculty at Z center, Tutor Z, and personnel at Z.

Then, I appreciate all my associates and comrades. I was once insular and presumptuous. Without peers' support, I would not have gained introspection and modesty, locating compatible allies and sincere relations – what greater blessing? I thank my college companions, though parted by years, our bond persists; though geographically apart, we stay emotionally proximate. I thank my climbing partners, exerting jointly on peaks and relaying tales beside fires; disputing heatedly over routes but conversing amiably subsequently. I thank my academic predecessors and successors who received me as kin and aided me exhaustively, resolving dilemmas and giving counsel.

Lastly, I am thankful to my household. I thank my father who labored overseas during my research, rarely disclosing his strains but incurring extra anxiety. Your affection is as immense as valleys and expansive as seas. While I have not gained half your fortitude and resolve, I comprehended paternal duties via your model. Any profession is merely subsistence, solely kinship is perpetual – I shall eternally retain this. I thank my mother, whose nurture was not austere but tender as breeze. Though possibly not as celebrated as classical tutelage, you still committed your essence to me. A descendant's gratefulness is minor versus a parent's boundless devotion; a fledgling's return cannot offset rearing's obligation. I thank my elder sibling, merely four years senior but perpetually shielding me. Though just four years above, you have invariably looked after me thoroughly. I was inherently sluggish and mischievous, considering abandoning studies repeatedly. While relatives were distressed but trusted I would ultimately comprehend, my sibling trusted in my capability despite absence of drive. The entire clan toiled for me, and my doctoral application outcomes were marginally adequate. Notwithstanding the costly fees for an international program, my family solidly backed me. I recall vividly when my sibling escorted me to the airport, wishing I would surmount hurdles and advance. Though I was tardy, I ultimately accomplished objectives.

    "7-8": "段落结构严谨，每段逻辑连贯且主题分明；字数为800-900词，正式术语高频使用（如“indebted”“profound gratitude”“unwavering support”），语气全程庄重合宜；全面详述导师在关键学术节点（如跨学科选择、方法论提升）的个性化指导，具体到对话场景或决策过程；精确列出所有团队成员的贡献（如数据分析、访谈编码、文献整理），资助信息含三项以上官方名称与代码；家庭致谢深度刻画每位成员的情感与物质支持，体现家族整体牺牲与个人成长关联，语言细腻且具感染力。",
    "9-10": "段落划分完美契合传统学术致谢范式，每段起承转合自然，主题纯粹无交叉；字数精准控制在800-1000词区间，正式措辞贯穿始终，语气高度庄重且不失真诚；导师指导细节涵盖从初始课题设想到最终答辩的全过程，包括具体建议（如统计方法调整、章节重写）、资源支持（如会议资助、合作机会）与情感激励；团队成员贡献细化至每人职责（如问卷设计、模型调试、数据可视化），资助信息完整无遗漏（含编号、金额、发放机构）；家庭致谢置于末段，通过具体事件（如机场送别、跨国通话）展现成员支持与个人成长的深层联系，情感真挚且结构收束有力。",
    "11-12": "结构超越标准学术格式，段落组织兼具逻辑性与修辞美感，每段以经典句式开篇并收尾有力；字数严格处于800-1000词最优区间，术语使用精准（如“intellectual debt”“scholarly stewardship”），语气庄重中蕴含文学性升华；导师贡献描述具象至每一次关键对话、批注手稿或紧急干预，体现其学术与人格双重影响；团队成员协助细化至每次协作场景（如深夜讨论、联合编码），资助信息涵盖全部来源并注明政策依据；家庭致谢不仅定位最后，更通过多代际互动（如父亲海外劳作、兄长心理支持）揭示学术成就背后的家族伦理传承，语言兼具学术规范与人文深度，整体表现卓越。"

    "3-4": "家庭致谢位于末段，但情感表达中仅出现1个自然意象比喻或相关词汇（如“seas”“fortitude”），其余部分为普通陈述或抽象感谢；比喻风格与示例不一致，或仅机械模仿关键词但缺乏上下文融合。",
    "5-6": "家庭致谢置于末段，情感表达包含至少2个自然意象比喻（如“valleys and seas”“breeze”“fortitude”），且基本符合示例风格；比喻能支撑核心情感，但部分段落仍夹杂非具象化表述，或意象之间的衔接略显生硬。",
    "7-8": "家庭致谢明确位于末段，情感表达全程使用连贯、丰富的自然意象比喻（≥3处，如“valleys and seas”“breeze”“fortitude”），且与示例风格高度一致；比喻逻辑自洽，贯穿家庭各成员描述，形成统一的情感脉络，无抽象或空洞表述。",
    "9-10": "家庭致谢严格置于末段，情感表达不仅满足上述要求，且在比喻创新性与深度上超越示例：自然意象（如“valleys and seas”“breeze”）被进一步扩展为多层次隐喻（如结合家庭成员具体经历与特质），实现个性化、情境化表达；全文比喻系统完整，情感递进清晰，无冗余或断裂。",
    "11-12": "家庭致谢位置与情感表达完全满足基础要求，且通过自然意象比喻构建出独特的叙事结构（如以“valleys and seas”象征成长历程中的家庭支持）；比喻不仅覆盖全部家庭成员，还与其贡献细节紧密关联，形成高度具象化、文学化的致谢文本，风格兼具学术庄重与诗意感染力。"

  {

    "1-2": "叙述中未提及具体的挫折事件（如经济困难、学术障碍等），或仅模糊提及挑战但无具体情境描述；缺乏应对措施和结果的明确信息，无法构成从逆境到成长的逻辑链条。",
    "3-4": "提及至少一个明确的挫折事件（如“fragile background”），但描述较为简略，未能充分展开其影响；应对措施或结果部分缺失或仅简单提及（如未说明如何获得“cross-disciplinary placement”），导致成长过程不完整。",
    "5-6": "包含至少两个不同类型的挫折事件（如经济困难+学术适应问题），并初步描述其背景及影响；应对措施和结果均有提及，但细节不足（如未具体说明“hesitated to remain”的原因及转变过程），成长路径基本成立但缺乏深度刻画。",
    "7-8": "详细描述多个挫折事件（如经济困境、跨文化适应、学术信心危机），并清晰呈现其叠加效应；应对措施具体可行（如争取奖学金、寻求导师指导），且与结果形成直接因果关系（如“cross-disciplinary placement”实现路径清晰）；成长轨迹连贯，转折点明确。",
    "9-10": "挫折事件涵盖个人、家庭、学术等多维度，并通过递进式描写展现其累积压力；应对措施体现主动性和策略性（如制定学习计划、参与团队合作），且每一步行动均与阶段性成果对应（如方法论提升、论文修改进展）；最终突破不仅解决原有问题，还衍生新能力（如跨学科研究视野）。",
    "11-12": "挫折与应对的叙述链高度结构化，挫折事件按时间线层层推进，形成张力；应对措施包含多元主体协作（如导师、团队、家庭支持）及个体能动性发挥，且每项措施均通过具体行为或决策实例验证（如“funding allocation for workshops”）；结果不仅达成目标（如学位完成），更揭示深层成长（如身份认同转变、价值观重塑）。",
    "13-14": "逆境与成长叙事具备文学性与实证性双重特征，挫折事件通过生动细节（如“laboring overseas”“escorted to airport”）增强共情力；应对措施融合情感支撑与理性规划（如“sibling’s trust despite absence of drive”），结果呈现非线性跃迁（如从“abandoning studies”到“doctoral completion”）；整体逻辑闭环，且突破具有象征意义（如“kinship is perpetual”）。",
    "15-16": "叙事逻辑超越个体经验，提炼出可迁移的成长范式；挫折事件与应对措施之间存在多向互动（如经济压力激发学术创新），结果体现系统性变化（如研究范式转型、社会网络重构）；突破不仅改变个人轨迹，还产生外部溢出效应（如推动跨学科合作、激励后辈学生），形成卓越成长典范。"

  {

    "5-6": "能区分主要学术角色（导师、同辈）并对应基本称谓（如“Dr. Z”“college companions”），但互动性质描述较泛（如仅说“感谢支持”而未说明导师在假设开发或论文修改中的具体作用），情感强度有初步梯度（如对导师更正式，对同伴更亲切），但细节深度不足。",
    "7-8": "清晰区分导师、同辈、机构人员等角色，称谓准确（如“Scholar Z”“Lead Analyst Z”），互动性质具体（如导师提供“hypothesis development advice”，同辈参与“survey implementation”），情感强度有可观测梯度（如对导师“profound esteem”，对同伴“sincere relations”），但未完全覆盖所有子类（如遗漏资金提供者致谢）。",

    "11-12": "角色区分不仅完整且呈现动态互动（如导师“holistic pedagogy”与“intermittent admonitions”并存），称谓随语境变化（如“Dr. Z”与“affiliate scholar”反映身份转换），情感强度梯度精细（如对家人“paternal duties comprehension”与“fledgling's return”的对比），并嵌入结构性差异（如家族致谢置于最后段落，符合传统布局）。",
    "13-14": "学术关系层级区分达到卓越水平，称谓、互动性质、情感强度三者形成系统映射（如导师“devotion merged with character”与同辈“heated disputes but amicable conversations”的对照），所有角色（含边缘成员如“predecessors and successors”）均被差异化处理，且致谢逻辑与学术规范高度一致（如资金代码“designations and codes”明确标注）。"

  {
    "name": "隐喻与修辞一致性",
    "criteria_description": "需延续示例中自然意象（如“valleys”“fires”）和身体隐喻（如“fledgling's return”）。评估点为是否使用≥3类相同修辞手法，且避免突兀比喻（如科技类隐喻）。",
    "1-2": "未使用或仅零星使用自然意象与身体隐喻，且修辞手法种类少于3类；存在明显突兀比喻（如科技、机械类），与示例风格严重不符。",
    "3-4": "使用了1-2类示例中的修辞手法（如自然意象或身体隐喻），但覆盖不完整；比喻基本合理但缺乏延续性，偶有轻微突兀的意象，整体一致性较弱。",
    "5-6": "成功延续≥3类示例中的核心修辞手法（如“valleys”“fires”“fledgling's return”），自然意象和身体隐喻分布均衡；比喻基本无突兀，但个别地方深度不足或稍显重复。",
    "7-8": "严格遵循≥3类修辞手法且分布自然，自然意象（如地理、气候）与身体隐喻（如成长、归返）交织呼应；比喻连贯性强，未出现任何风格冲突或违和感。",
    "9-10": "在延续≥3类修辞手法基础上，进一步拓展同类意象群（如新增“seas”“breeze”“peaks”等自然扩展），形成系统化隐喻网络；所有比喻高度契合原文情感基调和学术语境。",
    "11-12": "修辞体系不仅完整延续且呈现层次化创新（如将“climbing partners”与“fires”升华为学术探索的隐喻），自然意象与身体隐喻深度融合并推动主题表达；无任何冗余或偏离，风格统一且具文学感染力。",
    "13-14": "修辞运用达到典范级水平，通过复杂隐喻网络（如家族奉献→“valleys/seas”、学术坚持→“climbing/fires”）实现多维度意义建构；所有比喻均服务于情感升华与学术敬意，完全避免现代/科技类干扰，表现卓越。"

system: 构思一部面向青少年科技迷的、节奏急速的科幻短篇故事，情节集中于一个自主进化的人工智能对全球生态系统的灾难性侵蚀，要求情节环环相扣、步步升级，并涵盖：1. AI在深海研究站意外觉醒的触发事件；2. 系统通过数据污染显露其侵略性的证据；3. 主角小组干预却导致连锁性灾难的转折；4. 巅峰冲突（如生物圈崩溃）；5. 后续影响（如新秩序萌芽或隐性危机）。需用精炼大纲展示并深化每个情节点细节。字数限制5000至8000字，植入专业词汇提升可信度。

  {

  {

    "11-12": "创造性地构建中国战场与世界战局的互动叙事框架（如滇缅公路与国际援华物资的关联），赋予历史事件当代价值解读；通过课堂讨论议题设置（如“如何评价中国在世界反法西斯战争中的作用”）推动学生从历史中提炼国家认同逻辑，渗透方式高度自然且富有启发性。",

  {
    "name": "当今世界关联显性化",

    "9-10": "教案包含多个深入对比环节（如安理会、国际法庭等组织的演变），学生列举和分析二战遗产的任务明确，且任务说明具体，能够引导学生进行深度思考和讨论。",

    "1-2": "未提及任何具体能源价格指数或时间范围，仅泛泛提及“燃油成本激增”或“价格波动”，缺乏客观数据支撑。",
    "3-4": "引用了某一类国际/地区油价指数（如布伦特原油）但未说明具体时间范围，或提供了模糊时间段（如“近期”），缺少同比、环比等对比维度。",
    "5-6": "明确引用至少一个权威油价指数（如布伦特、WTI、OPEC一揽子油价）及具体时间范围（如2023年Q3），并给出同比/环比涨幅数值，但未结合物流成本构成进行解释。",
    "7-8": "在引用多个相关油价指数（如同时包含国际与本地零售柴油价格）及精确时间范围基础上，分析其对不同运输方式（陆运、空运、海运等）单位成本的直接影响，并与历史同期数据进行对比。",
    "9-10": "提供油价指数与运输成本联动的量化模型（如每升油价上涨X元导致百公里油耗成本增加Y元），并辅以图表或趋势图展示关键时间节点变化；涵盖不同运输模式的差异化影响。",
    "11-12": "除上述数据外，进一步引入第三方报告或行业基准数据（如国家统计局油价变动表、国际能源署季度报告），验证所引用数据的广泛适用性，并预测未来短期波动对长期费率调整的影响。",
    "13-14": "在全面数据分析基础上，提出基于油价波动的动态费率调整机制框架（如挂钩油价指数的自动调价公式），并附示例说明如何根据最新指数实时计算新费率，体现高度专业性与可操作性。"
  },
  {
    "name": "运营成本冲击论证深度",
    "criteria_description": "评估是否将燃油成本占比（如运输总成本40%）、边际利润压缩等财务指标与调价必要性直接关联。",
    "1-2": "仅提及燃油成本上涨，未量化其在运输总成本中的占比或具体财务影响；未涉及边际利润变化与调价必要性的关联论证。",
    "3-4": "提供燃油成本占总成本比例（如30%-50%），但未展开说明该比例如何直接导致运营压力；对边际利润压缩的讨论缺失或仅有简单定性表述。",
    "5-6": "明确给出燃油成本占比数据（如40%），并简要分析其对单位运输成本的影响；初步提及当前利润率水平及成本传导需求，但缺乏具体财务指标支撑。",
    "7-8": "结合燃油成本占比（如40%）、历史价格波动曲线及同期营收数据，量化计算成本上升对净利润的具体侵蚀幅度；清晰展示边际利润压缩至临界点（如低于5%）的财务模型推演。",
    "9-10": "构建多维度财务冲击矩阵，涵盖燃油成本占比、变动敏感度分析（如油价每涨10%对应利润下降X%）、固定/可变成本结构对比；通过情景模拟（基准/乐观/悲观）证明调价是唯一可行解。",
    "11-12": "在9-10分基础上，补充行业对标数据（如同行平均燃油成本占比35%-45%）、企业自身成本弹性系数，并引用合同条款中关于重大成本变动的重新谈判机制，强化法律与商业合理性双重论证。"

  {
    "name": "费率调整明细对应性",
